jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives!**

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **Oakland, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 20 hours per week
* **Job Location:** Oakland, CA
* **Pay rate:** $21.00/hr

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**About us**

LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.

**Our Benefits**

In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program

Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off

**About the Position**

The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.

**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**

* Empower children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing after-school education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go after school to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Education and/or Experience and/or License Certification:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing services.
* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or related field preferred.
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support individuals and families so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? Apply today!!!

**Please Note**

***LifeSTEPS values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at LifeSTEPS means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected, and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status. Please provide us with notice if you will require accommodations during the interview process***

Our Compute team makes sure that capacity lands on time and that every team across the company works from the same accurate plan. We're looking for a Program Manager who will own the programs that take new infrastructure from commitment to production: running timelines and dependencies, holding partners and teammates to their commitments, surfacing risk early, and building AI-native processes that make delivery predictable as we scale.

* Run multiple concurrent infrastructure programs: milestones, dependencies, owners, decisions and handoffs as capacity is validated and brought into service
* Act as the day-to-day operating counterpart to external infrastructure partners; hold them to commitments and escalate when things slip, while maintaining productive relationships
* Maintain the tracking, dashboards and reporting cadence that give leadership clear visibility into program status and blockers, and turn it into concise updates up to the executive team

jobs.title: SSVF Case Manager, East Bay
jobs.description:
**About Swords to Plowshares**

Founded in 1974, Swords to Plowshares is a community-based not-for-profit organization that provides counseling and case management, employment and training, housing, and legal assistance to veterans in the San Francisco Bay Area. We promote and protect the rights of veterans through advocacy, public education, and partnerships with local, state, and national entities. Believing that war causes wounds and suffering that last beyond the battlefield, our mission is to support veterans as they navigate the challenges of post-military life, and to prevent and end veteran homelessness through wrap-around care and informed advocacy. To learn more about Swords to Plowshares, please visit our website at www.swords-to-plowshares.org .

**Job Title:** SSVF Case Manager, East Bay

**Location:** 330 Franklin St. Suite 100, Oakland, CA 94607

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday; 9:00 am -5:00pm

**Reporting Type:** In-person

**Employment Type:** Full-time, non-exempt

**Salary Range:** $30.77

**Summary Of Position**

The Case Manager will work in collaboration with the SSVF Program Team and Drop-In Program staff to identify appropriate permanent housing and/or eviction prevention interventions for veterans enrolled in the program. The Case Manager will provide case management services to veteran households transitioning into permanent housing, as well as those at risk of losing their housing. Utilizing evidence-based best practices, the Case Manager will assess, enroll, and refer veterans to permanent housing and transitional placement services, or assist veteran families with homelessness prevention services.

The Case Manager will develop and maintain community partnerships with Supportive Housing Programs, the VA VASH Voucher Program, and market-rate landlords to expand housing opportunities and strengthen eviction prevention efforts. They will work to ensure a smooth transition into permanent housing and maintain supportive relationships with veterans to promote long-term housing stability within the community. This role also includes serving as a resource for staff regarding housing placements and housing applications.

This position reports to the SSVF Program Managers and/or SSVF Program Coordinators and Program Director.

**Responsibilities:**

· Perform intakes and assessments to determine program eligibility and place program participants into permanent housing; coordinate eviction prevention services; review and update individualized Housing Stability Plans as needed.

· Maintain case management functions, including record keeping and client services.

· Refer and connect veteran clients with supportive services and community resources.

· Enter and maintain HMIS, ETO, and ECS data and client records.

· Conduct both in-person and remote housing inspections throughout San Francisco, Alameda, San Mateo, Contra Costa, and Marin Counties.

· Maintain a working understanding of veteran readjustment challenges, including Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI), alcohol and drug dependency, and other mental health conditions by attending trainings and utilizing resources offered by the SSVF leadership team.

· Adhere to laws regarding confidentiality and reporting requirements; maintain knowledge of current HIPAA policies and procedures.

· Assist veteran households with money management and budgeting as needed.

jobs.description:
This is an 18-month contract position (with the possibility of extension dependent on funding).

The Project Manager’s role is to manage the development and implementation of technology projects as well as support ongoing APeX Enabled Research (AER) operations. Most project resources will be through partnership with other UCSF entities, and/or via 3rd party vendors, thus communication skills and a strong ability to work across organizational boundaries is crucial.

Provides “go-to” project leadership and owns delivery of multiple small- to large-scale technology projects from intake and initiation through implementation and closeout. Ensures projects maintain momentum by proactively managing decisions, dependencies, risks, blockers, approvals, scope, timelines, budgets, and resources, and escalating issues when resolution requires leadership intervention.

The incumbent guides AER project team(s) by: providing measurable, client-focused approaches to project and release management; assisting with change management and project coaching; providing regular analysis and feedback on all phases of projects to AER leadership team; building and sustaining lasting relationships with project sponsorship and partners.

Our Business Operations team sits at the heart of the Distributed Systems Engineering (DSE) organization, providing the operational backbone that empowers our engineers to innovate at scale. We partner directly with SVP-level leadership to turn complex engineering visions into reality, ensuring that our resources, budgets, and critical initiatives are perfectly aligned. We are a dynamic, collaborative group that thrives on solving complex problems and bridging the gap between technical execution and business strategy. Joining us means being part of a high-visibility team where your work directly enables the success of the entire Infrastructure Engineering organization.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As the Business Operations Manager, you will serve as the trusted strategic partner and operational engine for our VP of Engineering. You will:
  
  

* Drive end-to-end operational planning, governance, and organizational cadence, leading staff meetings, all-hands forums, and strategic execution workstreams.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

**About the team**

The People team is the engine behind World’s most important asset: its people. We build, support, and scale a global organization of exceptional talent. We design experiences that attract world-class builders and retain, recognize, reward, and enable them to do the best work of their lives.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a People Operations Manager to shape how employees and managers experience working at World, from onboarding through major career and life changes. You’ll own how our core People programs run today and help shape where we invest next. You’ll use employee feedback, support trends, and your own experience handling complex cases to set priorities, bring the right partners together, and see improvements through rollout. Success means employees can get routine things done easily and count on thoughtful, accurate support when the stakes are high.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead day-to-day operations across onboarding, mobility, benefits, compensation, and sensitive organizational changes. Handle complex requests from intake through resolution, keeping employees and managers informed along the way
* Use employee feedback and support trends to spot where people get stuck. Recommend what to fix first, make the change, and check whether it reduced delays or repeat questions
* Keep employee data accurate. Run regular audits, resolve discrepancies, and fix the underlying process when the same errors recur
* Make workflows easier to run as volume grows. Simplify handoffs, automate repetitive steps, and give the team clear guidance for handling exceptions

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* The ability to break a process down into its core components and identify the root causes for gaps or inefficiencies
* Strong operational judgment and experience handling sensitive, time-critical employee matters with precision, empathy, and clear written communication
* Hands-on experience maintaining accurate employee data and building reports in an HR system, ideally Workday, along with experience automating repetitive workflows using tools such as Google Apps Script, Python, or SQL
* Proven cross-functional influence - bringing Legal, Finance, and People stakeholders together to resolve ambiguity and move decisions forward
* An appetite for the day-to-day work of People Operations, from personally guiding an employee through a difficult case to improving the process for the next person

*Pay transparency statement (for CA and NY based roles):*

*The reasonably estimated salary for this role at TFH ranges from* ***$203,000 - $225,000****, plus a competitive long term incentive package. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, TFH offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) plan and match, life insurance, flexible time off, commuter benefits, professional development stipend and much more!*

*By submitting your application, you consent to the processing and internal sharing of your CV within the company, in compliance with the GDPR.*

jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Sunnyvale, CA

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**

**Department**
--------------

Hardware

  

Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.
  
  
This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.
  
  
Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

We are seeking a Trade Compliance Operations Manager to support the Global Operations team in keeping Cerebras’ international shipments compliant with import and export requirements. This role owns the operational side of trade compliance, including customs documentation, jurisdiction and classification, export controls, and regulatory record keeping, in a fast-paced hardware environment.

The Trade Compliance Operations Manager will prepare and review shipping documentation, maintain compliance trackers, work with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and internal teams, and improve compliance processes. The role connects closely with logistics, supply chain, warehouse, finance, and legal. It requires the ability to work quickly, understand enough about Cerebras’ technology and risk profile to ask the right questions, and bring structure to the company’s trade program.

**Key Responsibilities**

The Manager will manage day-to-day trade compliance operations, escalating compliance risks to the Global Operations and Trade Compliance leadership as needed.

* Prepare and review international shipping documents, such as commercial invoices, packing lists, and airway bills, for accuracy and completeness.

* Manage customs clearance activities by working with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and internal teams to resolve open documentation requests and holds.

* Maintain product classification records, including HTS and export control classification information, and resolve missing or inconsistent data.

* Run export control and restricted party screening processes, and track items that need review or approval before shipment.

* Maintain trade compliance trackers, such as license and permit status, shipment holds, duty and tariff items, and open compliance issues.

* Organize and retain import and export records in line with regulatory and company record keeping requirements.

* Document process steps and gaps, and drive improvements to trade compliance and export/customs execution.

* Coordinate with Logistics, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Finance, and Legal to close compliance-related open items.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, International Business, Logistics, Law, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 5+ years of experience in trade compliance, customs, import/export operations, or international logistics.

* Working knowledge of customs procedures, HTS classification, export controls, country of origin, and sanctions or restricted party screening.

* Familiar with ACE portal to monitor both Import & Export shipments.

* Familiarity with domestic and international trade programs and regimes such as duty drawback, CTPAT, or USMCA.

* Be the subject matter expert for current trade environment for tariffs, supporting sourcing teams to come up with sourcing strategies to mitigate tariffs and optimizing logistics costs at the same time.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to keep records, trackers, and documentation accurate and organized.

* Proficiency in Excel or similar tools to maintain trackers and produce reports. The ability to use AI to maintain and enhance such tasks is a plus.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with clear and prompt follow-up with internal teams, brokers, and logistics partners.

* Familiarity with implementing system controls related to trade compliance and ability to partner with IT, legal, engineering and other stakeholders for implementation. NetSuite experience preferred.

* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and follow established procedures.

**Location**: Sunnyvale, CA

The base salary range for this position is $190,000 to $230,000 annually. Actual compensation may include bonus and equity, and will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications.

**Why Join Cerebras**

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras:

* Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU.

* Publish and open source their cutting-edge AI research.

* Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world.

* Enjoy job stability with startup vitality.

* Our simple, non-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs.

  

**Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!**

*Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.*

Additionally, you will establish standardized estimating workflows, templates, and baseline tracking tied to key design milestones. Finally, you will integrate cost management systems and collaborates cross-functionally as an estimating expert to mitigate financial risks.

jobs.title: Regional Quality Manager: Home Health
jobs.description:
**21st Century Home Health Services (21HHS)** is dedicated to delivering exceptional care to its patients while fostering a supportive and rewarding environment for its employees. The company consistently achieves hospital readmission rates below 10%—well under the industry average of more than 15%. It has also earned recognition as a 2024 Top Workplace, highlighting its culture of open communication, professional growth, empowerment, and appreciation.

As the fastest-growing home health agency in Northern California, 21HHS recently expanded into Marin and Sonoma counties, extending its reach while maintaining a reputation for excellence. Positive reviews across platforms such as Yelp, Google, Glassdoor, and Indeed reflect both the quality of care provided to patients and the outstanding experience of its employees, reinforcing its leadership in the home health industry.

We're looking for a Regional Quality Manager who's driven by outcomes: better patient care, stronger clinical practice, and a team that feels genuinely supported. You'll set the standard for how care gets delivered across your region — building systems that hold up in the field, not just on paper.

If you find satisfaction in spotting what's not working, coaching teams toward better ways of doing it, and building a culture where quality is everyone's job, we'd love to meet you.

  

*This is not a remote opportunity. The position requires you to be onsite at one of our local offices (Walnut Creek, San Jose, Burlingame, Sacramento)*

### **What You'll Do:**

* Design and deliver targeted clinical education based on readmission data and the patterns behind it.
* Hold weekly office hours to coach clinicians on high-risk areas, including OASIS accuracy, discharge planning and patient education.
* Develop role-specific training curricula that address gaps found through readmission root cause analysis.
* Build and maintain a complete training library on our eLearning platform.
* Make sure all new hires complete their onboarding competencies and certifications on time.
* Manage the region's education calendar, choosing topics from real audit findings, incident trends and clinician feedback rather than a static annual checklist.

### **Quality Assurance & QAPI Leadership**

* Develop and oversee the regional Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, including its dashboards, audit tools, reporting cadence and committee structure.
* Track the metrics that matter: CMS Quality Measures, SHP KPIs, potentially avoidable events (PAEs), readmission and hospitalization rates, start-of-care timeliness, star ratings, patient satisfaction, and charting quality and timeliness.
* Run internal audits, chart reviews and field observations, then turn what you find into corrective action plans with measurable outcomes.
* Keep the region ready for external audits and accreditation reviews (CHAP, Kaiser) year-round instead of scrambling at the last minute.
* Standardize best practices across branches, replacing one-off workarounds with clear, repeatable processes clinicians can follow in the field.
* Investigate incidents, complaints and adverse events with a systems lens. Find what allowed the failure, not just who was involved, and put safeguards in place so it doesn't happen again.

### **Readmission Analysis & Readmission Nurse Coordination**

* Work directly with readmission nurses to analyze trends in readmissions, hospital transfers and PAEs.
* Make sure all readmission and PAE reports are complete, timely and clinically accurate.
* Train readmission nurses on root cause analysis methods and reporting procedures.
* Find the clinical competency gaps behind poor outcomes, design targeted interventions, and share patterns with clinical supervisors and educators.
* Coordinate readmission follow-ups and patient education to prevent repeat admissions.
* Report quarterly on readmission metrics and on how well education and interventions are working.

### **Overseas Concierge Oversight**

* Partner with outsourced overseas concierge managers to set quality standards and performance expectations.
* Review concierge call recordings and documentation for quality.
* Monitor concierge metrics, including call quality, documentation accuracy and adherence to escalation procedures.
* Make sure concierges are trained on 21st Century protocols and quality expectations, work with managers on improvement plans, and escalate significant issues to senior leadership.

### **Performance Improvement & Staff Development**

* Support clinical supervisors in putting performance improvement plans (PIPs) in place for clinicians with quality gaps, and track progress with documented outcomes.
* Coach clinicians through real-time feedback, competency assessments and targeted education that builds skill rather than just documenting it.
* Develop clinical supervisors so quality oversight is shared across the team instead of depending on you.
* Recommend professional development opportunities for clinical staff.
* Promote continuous learning and psychological safety, so staff raise concerns early and near-misses are treated as chances to learn.

### **Leadership & Partnership**

* Act as a working partner to regional and site leadership, not an outside auditor. Sit in on operations meetings, understand each location's constraints, and build improvement plans that fit how each team actually runs.
* Align quality goals with staffing, scheduling and growth plans, including new locations, service line expansion and system rollouts.
* Give senior leadership clear, honest updates on what's improving, what isn't, and what resources the region needs.
* Use patient and family concerns as a quality signal. Resolve them quickly, follow through personally, and turn complaint patterns into process changes.
* Share quality outcomes with external partners such as Kaiser, using performance data, star ratings and satisf

jobs.title: EHS Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

APTIM is seeking a Senior EHS Manager to lead environmental, health, and safety programs supporting a multidisciplinary research and development laboratory environment in the greater Seattle area.

In this role, you will partner with researchers, laboratory leadership, and operations teams to address complex safety challenges and integrate safe practices into evolving research activities. You will provide strategic direction and hands-on technical expertise across chemical safety, industrial hygiene, laser and non-ionizing radiation safety, lithium-ion batteries, and biosafety.

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:**

* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of laboratory EHS programs.
* Serve as a senior technical advisor to researchers and leadership on laboratory hazards, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
* Conduct and oversee exposure assessments, industrial hygiene monitoring, hazard evaluations, and control recommendations.
* Evaluate new research activities, equipment, materials, and laboratory modifications to identify hazards and establish appropriate safeguards.
* Lead inspections, incident investigations, and corrective actions to strengthen laboratory safety performance.
* Oversee chemical management, hazard communication, compressed-gas safety, and hazardous-material storage practices.
* Develop laboratory safety procedures, emergency-response plans, and employee training.
* Partner with facilities, engineering, and operations teams to incorporate safety into laboratory design and daily operations.
* Monitor program performance, communicate priorities to leadership, and mentor EHS and laboratory personnel.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in industrial hygiene, occupational safety, environmental health, chemistry, biology, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of progressively responsible EHS experience, including leadership of laboratory or R&D safety programs.
* Strong knowledge of laboratory hazards, industrial hygiene practices, and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Experience conducting exposure assessments, interpreting monitoring results, and implementing effective hazard controls.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives, exercise independent judgment, and influence cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and EHS documentation systems.
* Ability to work onsite in the greater Seattle area at least three days per week and travel between local laboratory locations.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and an acceptable driving record.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment and work safely in laboratory environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a related discipline.
* Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certified Safety Professional (CSP), or comparable certification.
* Experience supporting multiple laboratory locations.
* Specialized experience in laser safety, biosafety, non-ionizing radiation, or lithium-ion battery research and testing.
* Current HAZWOPER training.

**About APTIM**

APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.

What you can expect from APTIM:

* Work that is worthy of your time and talent
* Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
* Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
* A voice in making our company better
* Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $120-$150K per year and depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

**Employee Benefits**

APTIM Environmental & Infrastructure, LLC is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families through the APTIM Benefits Marketplace https://aptim.makeityoursource.com/.

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and several carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
* Company paid and optional Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity coverage
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave (eligibility based on company policy and applicable law)
* 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here:

* + APTIM 401(k) Guide
  + APTIM - Helpful Documents

**APTIM's Environmental Consulting Business was recently acquired by Trinity Consultants, and we expect to complete our transition to Trinity Consultants by January 1, 2027. We are continuing to recruit for these critical positions to serve our clients and core end markets throughout this transition. While your initial conversations and recruiting materials may reference APTIM, we want to acknowledge that upon hire you will be employed through Trinity Consultants.**

Compensation, Benefits & Payroll

Performance Management, Training & Development

* Assist in the development and execution of performance management systems and employee evaluation processes.

* Support initiatives for employee engagement, retention, recognition, and morale-building programs.

HR Systems, Documentation & Reporting

Other Responsibilities

jobs.description:
Position Type:

Location(s):

United States, San Mateo, CA

**Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?**

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**Global Accounts Payable & Expense Operations Analyst - Contingent Worker**

**Position Summary**

The Accounts Payable & Expense Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP), Travel & Expense (T&E),operations while serving as the functional subject matter expert for enterprise financial systems. This role combines operational excellence with systems expertise to ensure accurate invoice processing, employee expense reimbursements, supplier management, corporate card administration, payment operations, and enterprise application support.

The position partners closely with Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Human Resources, Payroll, IT, external vendors, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) providers to ensure efficient, compliant, and reliable financial operations across a global organization. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and experienced in supporting enterprise applications including Coupa Invoicing, Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM), SAP Concur, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText Vendor Invoice Management (VIM), and related financial systems.

Routine AP and Expense transactional operations are primarily performed by the BPO provider. This role oversees BPO service delivery, monitors operational performance and controls, supports the resolution of escalated issues, and drives process and system improvements. The Analyst may also directly perform selected operational activities to support exceptions, escalations, transitions, business continuity, or other operational requirements.

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid (2–3 days per week in the office based on business and team requirements).

**Key Responsibilities**

Depending on business needs and the defined operating model, the responsibilities below may be fulfilled through oversight of the BPO provider, direct execution by the Analyst, or a combination of both. **Accounts Payable & Supplier Operations**

* Process supplier invoices accurately using Coupa Invoicing, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText VIM, and related applications.
* Process Relish invoices and ensure timely and accurate payment processing.
* Manage supplier onboarding, registration, maintenance, and vendor master records through Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM).
* Review, validate, and resolve invoice discrepancies, exceptions, and workflow issues.
* Perform vendor account reconciliations and resolve outstanding balances.
* Process and monitor supplier payments while ensuring compliance with company policies and financial controls.
* Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to Accounts Payable.
* Ensure compliance with SOX, audit requirements, tax regulations, and internal controls.

**Expense & Corporate Card Operations**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee expense reimbursement and corporate card issues outside the scope of the BPO provider.
* Administer Corporate Card programs across multiple regions, including account setup, maintenance, credit limit requests, delinquency monitoring, employee terminations, dormant account reviews, and dispute resolution.
* Investigate reimbursement issues, duplicate payments, rejected payment files, payment exceptions, and policy violations.
* Validate reimbursement payment batches and reconcile payment files prior to processing.
* Partner with Treasury, Payroll, HR, Procurement, Finance, Tax, and external vendors to resolve operational issues.
* Escalate significant financial, operational, or compliance risks to leadership.

**Enterprise Systems & Functional Support**

* Provide functional support for SAP Concur, Coupa, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText VIM, and related enterprise applications.
* Investigate and resolve application issues including:
  + Employee provisioning failures
  + ERP interface failures
  + SAP IDoc processing issues
  + Corporate Card feed failures
  + Expense application and mobile issues
  + Enterprise integration failures
* Analyze system dependencies, determine business impact, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with IT and software vendors.
* Support production issue validation and act as the functional liaison between Finance and IT.

**Testing, Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, system upgrades, releases, implementations, and application enhancements.
* Develop test plans, document defects, validate fixes, and coordinate production readiness.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and operational efficiencies across Accounts Payable and Expense functions.
* Participate in Finance transformation initiatives, Procure-to-Pay projects, and cross-functional business initiatives.
* Prepare operational reports and analyze performance metrics.

**Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process documentation, workflows, and system documentation.
* Create employee communications, FAQs, training materials, and job aids.
* Support knowledge transfer, cross-training, and business continuity planning.
* Maintain documentation reposit

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

The Moore Law Group is committed to superior compliance in legal collections. The firm emphasizes treating everyone it interacts with dignity, respect, compassion, and professionalism.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Process Documentation and Training Specialist develops and maintains documented workflows, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and role-specific training across The Moore Law Group. This position works directly with employees and department leaders to capture how work is performed, translate operational and client requirements into clear resources, and support consistent employee performance. The role coordinates a phased firmwide documentation effort and maintains accessible, current materials in collaboration with department leaders, Legal, Compliance, IT, and HR.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:
* Observe employees and interview department leaders to document responsibilities, systems, workflow steps, decision points, exceptions, and handoffs.
* Build and maintain a firmwide inventory of processes and existing documentation; coordinate priorities, deadlines, and a phased rollout with leadership.
* Create standardized procedures and detailed work instructions using screenshots, process maps, checklists, and examples as appropriate.
* Develop role-specific training presentations, onboarding resources, job aids, knowledge checks, and refresher materials based on approved procedures.
* Work with Client Services, Compliance, Legal, and department leaders to incorporate client requirements into procedures and training while preserving differences by client, state, or business channel.
* Use firm-approved AI tools to assist with content development and updates; protect confidential information and verify content with subject matter experts before publication.
* Coordinate department, legal, compliance, and client-related reviews and approvals before publishing materials.
* Organize a central, searchable collection of approved resources; collaborate with IT and HR to maintain SharePoint intranet content, accessibility, and publication practices.
* Establish document ownership, version control, review schedules, and update procedures to keep materials current as systems, workflows, and requirements change.
* Facilitate training as needed, gather employee and manager feedback, and revise materials to improve understanding and practical use.
* Travel to firm locations for employee observation, interviews, documentation, and training; perform other related duties as assigned.
* Establish consistent documentation and training templates, a firmwide process inventory, and a phased implementation plan with leadership.
* Complete approved procedures and role-specific training according to agreed priorities and deadlines.
* Maintain accurate, accessible materials that reflect approved practices and current client requirements, and use feedback to improve employee understanding and consistency.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)**

* Demonstrated professional experience documenting business processes, standard operating procedures, and detailed work instructions.
* Experience developing employee training, including presentations, onboarding resources, job aids, and assessments.
* Strong interviewing and observation skills, including the ability to identify steps and exceptions that experienced employees may not readily explain.
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex tasks into clear, practical instructions.
* Strong organization and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple departments, priorities, review cycles, and deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and PowerPoint and the ability to learn unfamiliar business systems.
* Practical experience using AI tools, or the ability to learn them quickly, with careful attention to accuracy and confidential information.
* Ability to work effectively with employees at all levels and obtain cooperation, feedback, and approvals across departments.
* Willingness and ability to travel to firm locations, including West Coast offices.
* Experience organizing or managing SharePoint content, preferred.
* Experience in legal services, financial services, collections, insurance, or another regulated environment, preferred.
* Familiarity with instructional design, adult learning principles, process mapping, screen recording, or e-learning tools, preferred.
* Experience building documentation or training programs across multiple departments or locations, preferred.
* Experience translating client requirements into operational procedures and employee training, preferred.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

As a Community Guide Case Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting our most vulnerable members, many dual-eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, through their most complex and serious situations, such as housing loss, safety concerns, and suspected abuse or neglect. When these challenges arise, cross-functional teams refer members to us for comprehensive support. As a Case Manager, you will build trusting, ongoing relationships with members and caregivers, create person-centered care plans, and remove barriers until goals are met. Reporting to a Community Guide Supervisor, you will use sound judgment and deep knowledge of community, behavioral health, and benefits resources to help members stay safe and stable, and you will strengthen the whole team by consulting on complex cases and coaching peers. This role is ideal for those dedicated to walking alongside members through their hardest moments as they navigate complex healthcare networks, community initiatives, and support resources.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

  

* Manage a caseload of members with complex, ongoing needs, building person-centered care plans with members and caregivers and following through until goals are met.
* Independently handle serious situations, including members expressing suicidal ideation, chronically unhoused members, housing loss or facility discharge, and suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation that requires an APS referral, following crisis and safety protocols.
* Lead emotionally complex conversations with members and caregivers, guiding them toward decisions rather than only sharing information.
* Remove barriers by connecting members directly to housing, behavioral health, long-term care, community, and benefits resources, and confirm that services were received.
* Coordinate with providers, teams across the health plan and Devoted Medical, community organizations, and government agencies so members don’t have to repeat their story.
* Anticipate risks before they become crises, look for root causes of recurring issues, and bring member patterns and proposed solutions to team leadership.
* Strengthen the team by leading or joining case conferences, consulting on complex cases, and coaching teammates on uncovering members’ underlying needs.
* Support the team’s core work, including common needs and benefit applications, during high-volume periods.
* Document thoroughly and track your own caseload outcomes, adjusting your approach before a leader needs to ask.

***Required skills and experience:***

  

* 2+ years of case management, care coordination, or social services experience supporting people with complex needs.
* Sound judgment in high-risk situations (crisis, safety concerns, suspected abuse or neglect), including knowing when and how to escalate.
* Strong verbal and written communication: you break down complex information clearly and handle emotionally sensitive conversations with composure.
* Strong organization to manage an ongoing caseload, competing priorities, and accurate documentation across multiple systems.
* Resilience and a growth mindset: you seek feedback, stay steady through change, and keep showing up for members when resources are limited, ability to work outside your job description in some instances, including the potential for taking inbound calls.
* Comfort with technology, including learning new systems and AI-enabled tools quickly.
Ability to work an assigned schedule within hours of operation (8:30am–8:00pm Eastern), supporting the Mountain or Pacific time zone if needed.  

  
  

***Desired skills and experience:***

  

* Degree in social work (BSW, MSW, LSW, LMSW, or LCSW) or a related field preferred but not required; equivalent demonstrated experience is considered.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish or Haitian Creole.
* Experience working with older adults, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid programs.

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

**Location:** Remote  
**Reports to:** Vice President of Operations  
**Position Type:** Temporary (Estimated duration: Jan - May 2027)

Scene Health is on a mission to solve medication non-adherence. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, technologists, and public health enthusiasts building high-impact, patient-centered solutions.

jobs.title: Sales Enrollment Specialist
jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
Wellcove has been recognized as the nation’s leading full-service senior market solutions provider for over 25 years. Our solutions span the insurance senior market sector, focusing on long-term care and Medicare Supplement plans. However, we don’t stop there. Wellcove also addresses challenges faced in accident & health, disability, and supplemental health insurance programs.
  
  
Our team provides individuals and their families with peace of mind knowing their insurance needs will be met in a thoughtful, efficient manner. We are able to do this because of our dedicated associates, innovative solutions, and state-of-the-art technology.
  
  
Sales Enrollment Specialist
  
Job Purpose
  
The Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) Enrollment Specialist is responsible for facilitating the enrollment of insureds who receive home care services from Agencies. This position primarily conducts outbound and inbound telephone outreach to educate Agencies, Caregivers, Claimants, and Authorized Representatives, collectively (“Stakeholders”), on the benefits of Wellcove's EVV program and convince them to enroll, guide them through the enrollment process, train them on the tools and platform, answer questions, and ensure all enrollment requirements are completed accurately and timely.
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong communication, sales, and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively educate and motivate Stakeholders, manage a regular call volume, handle objections, and maintain compliance with applicable state, federal, and program requirements.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:**  

* Conduct outbound and inbound phone calls to insureds, provider agencies, and caregivers, regarding EVV enrollment.
* Educate callers on EVV requirements, enrollment procedures, deadlines, and available support resources.
* Convince Stakeholders of the value of the Wellcove EVV program and motivate them to participate
* Guide to Stakeholders through the enrollment process, ensuring that all required information and documentation are obtained.
* Assist providers with complete enrollment forms, account setup, and system access.
* Verify enrollment information for accuracy and completeness.
* Document all customer interactions, enrollment activities, and case notes in the appropriate systems.
* Follow up with insureds and providers to obtain missing information and ensure timely completion of enrollment.
* Respond professionally to questions, concerns, and enrollment issues while providing exceptional customer service.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to resolve enrollment-related issues.
* Monitor assigned enrollment cases and meet established productivity, quality, and service-level expectations.
* Meet and exceed agency and claimant target enrollment percentages.
* Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and comply with HIPAA and all applicable state and federal regulations.
* Stay current on EVV program requirements, policies, and system updates.
* Provide training and guidance to clients on the use of EVV and Facility platforms, tools, and processes.
* Gather required information from Stakeholders and accurately record data in Wellcove’s platforms/systems.
* Maintain organized documentation for all client interactions, training sessions, and compliance activities.
* Provide outstanding customer service via phone and email, displaying professionalism, empathy, a sense of urgency, and a genuine willingness to help.
* Display professionalism, empathy, a sense of urgency, and a genuine willingness to help via phone and email.
* Independently process caller requests accurately and promptly in Wellcove’s proprietary system and escalate as appropriate.
* Comply with Sales Enrollment Specialist objectives and performance standards
* Willingness to learn new duties and technology-related skills as required.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**  

* Sales ability to promote the Wellcove EVV program and motivate Stakeholders to act on enrollment
* Proficiency with Microsoft office applications, Nitro, and the ability to learn multiple software applications.
* Accountable and able to work remotely and independently.
* Displays a positive ‘can do’/customer-first attitude.
* Ability to accurately document customer responses while simultaneously speaking with customers.
* Excellent communication skills and appropriate etiquette, great phone manners, and ability to speak with a wide range of personalities. Demonstrate a high level of proficiency in the use of the English language in oral and written forms.
* Collaborative team spirit.
* Ability to explain complex processes in a clear and easy-to-understand manner.
* Knowledge of HIPAA privacy requirements and confidentiality standards.
* Ability to meet performance metrics related to call volume, quality, and enrollment activation.
* Must have a dedicated remote work location free from background noises, interruptions, and desk clutter.
* Must have reliable internet connection and access to a smart phone.

**Education and Experience:**  

* High School or GED required
* Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred.
* Experience in a sales and/or call center environment

**Physical Requirements:**  

* Sedentary work. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
* Primarily remote call center environment.
* Extensive telephone communication throughout the workday.
* Frequent computer uses for documentation and enrollment processing.

**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

As a Bilingual (Spanish) Community Guide Case Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting our most vulnerable members, many dual-eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, through their most complex and serious situations, such as housing loss, safety concerns, and suspected abuse or neglect. When these challenges arise, cross-functional teams refer members to us for comprehensive support. As a Case Manager, you will build trusting, ongoing relationships with members and caregivers, create person-centered care plans, and remove barriers until goals are met. Reporting to a Community Guide Supervisor, you will use sound judgment and deep knowledge of community, behavioral health, and benefits resources to help members stay safe and stable, and you will strengthen the whole team by consulting on complex cases and coaching peers. This role is ideal for those dedicated to walking alongside members through their hardest moments as they navigate complex healthcare networks, community initiatives, and support resources.

* Manage a caseload of members with complex, ongoing needs, building person-centered care plans with members and caregivers and following through until goals are met.
* Independently handle serious situations, including members expressing suicidal ideation, chronically unhoused members, housing loss or facility discharge, and suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation that requires an APS referral, following crisis and safety protocols.
* Lead emotionally complex conversations with members and caregivers, guiding them toward decisions rather than only sharing information.
* Remove barriers by connecting members directly to housing, behavioral health, long-term care, community, and benefits resources, and confirm that services were received.

* Anticipate risks before they become crises, look for root causes of recurring issues, and bring member patterns and proposed solutions to team leadership.
* Strengthen the team by leading or joining case conferences, consulting on complex cases, and coaching teammates on uncovering members’ underlying needs.
* Support the team’s core work, including common needs and benefit applications, during high-volume periods.
* Document thoroughly and track your own caseload outcomes, adjusting your approach before a leader needs to ask.

* Sound judgment in high-risk situations (crisis, safety concerns, suspected abuse or neglect), including knowing when and how to escalate.

jobs.title: UM Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

The Program Manager for UM Operations is a high-impact, hands-on leader responsible for driving consistency, workforce readiness, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency across the Utilization Management (UM) department.

This role combines advanced UM expertise, program management, and data-driven decision-making to build and lead programs that help UM teams perform at their best. The Program Manager will lead a team, partner closely with UM leadership and the UM OPS Quality Team, and ensure UM programs meet Regulatory Guidelines and CMS Regulations.

This is a fast-paced, high-change environment requiring someone who thrives on operational challenges, can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and is comfortable building and scaling programs during rapid growth.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

**Program Leadership & Team Management:**

* Lead section, priorities, and standards that support consistent, compliant operations across UM.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for program outcomes and report results to UM leadership.

**Training Program Development:**

* Build, implement, and manage the UM training program, establishing consistent curriculum and standards across all UM teams.
* Design and develop role-based training content for clinical and non-clinical UM staff and Medical Directors, using adult learning principles.
* Create and maintain training materials, job aids, e-learning, and a central training library that reflects current policies, criteria, and regulatory requirements.
* Translate SOPs, medical policies, regulatory requirements, and system changes into clear, practical training.

**Onboarding & Ongoing Education:**

* Oversee onboarding for all new UM hires, including orientation, classroom training, supervised nesting, and readiness sign-off before independent work.
* Establish role-based competency and readiness standards and partner with operational leaders on new-hire progress.
* Manage recurring monthly education and ad hoc education for new policies, regulatory changes, system releases, and criteria updates.
* Partner with the UM OPS Quality Team to deliver re-education for staff with poor quality performance and confirm improvement.
* Track attendance, completion, and attestation to support audit and accreditation readiness.

**Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR) Program:**

* Build and manage the UM IRR program for clinical reviewers and Medical Directors, including methodology, case development, scoring, and passing standards.
* Administer IRR assessments on schedule, oversee remediation and retesting, and use results to guide education priorities.
* Ensure IRR processes and documentation meet accreditation, state, and CMS requirements, and present results to UM leadership and committees.

**Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement:**

* Build dashboards and reports that measure program effectiveness, including time to productivity, IRR results, education completion, and impact on quality and turnaround times.
* Analyze program, IRR, and quality data to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement across UM.
* Lead initiatives to streamline UM workflows, quality decision making, reduce administrative burden, and improve consistency.

**Technology & AI Enablement:**

* Partner with Quality, Data Science, and Engineering to support adoption of AI/LLM-assisted workflows, including human-in-the-loop review and responsible use.
* Use AI and learning technology to scale program delivery and improve efficiency.
* Manage the tools and systems used to schedule, track, and report program activity.

**Cross-Functional Partnership:**

* Partner with UM leaders to identify needs and reduce the time leaders spend building and delivering training.
* Work closely with the UM OPS Quality Team to turn audit findings into action while keeping training and auditing independent.
* Collaborate with Compliance, Medical Directors, Pharmacy, Clinical Policy, and HR/Talent on regulatory updates, policy changes, and hiring plans.

***Required skills and experience:***

* Active, unrestricted RN or LVNlicense with 5+ years of UM experience (inpatient, outpatient, post-acute, or appeals).
* 2+ years of experience in clinical education, or UM training.
* People leadership experience.
* In-depth knowledge of UM processes, medical necessity criteria, accreditation standards, Regulatory Guidelines, and CMS Regulations.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and project management skills.

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Experience building or managing a training program, including onboarding and IRR or competency assessments.
* Knowledge of Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care UM requirements.
* Experience with LMS platforms and AI/LLM-enabled workflows in a healthcare environment.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description:

The Senior Project Manager is a seasoned, experienced professional who leads distinct, well-defined projects within the Genex PMO from initiation through delivery. This fully qualified, journey-level role coordinates cross-functional teams — across Product, Engineering/IT, Operations, Client Services, Finance, and external partners — to bring specific projects to completion on time and within budget.

Working on problems of diverse scope, the Senior Project Manager demonstrates sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions and resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This role operates with little day-to-day supervision, receives general instructions on new assignments, and networks with senior internal and external personnel to manage competing interests and deliver measurable outcomes that support Enlyte’s mission to drive brighter outcomes for all.

Project Leadership & Delivery

* Own end-to-end delivery of one or more distinct projects, each with a clear beginning and end, coordinating the associated workstreams and resources
* Define and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, dependencies, and RAID logs
* Translate requirements into clear execution plans, performing feasibility and needs/impact assessments
* Ensure projects are delivered on agreed scope, timelines, budget, and quality standards

Governance

* Run effective project cadence meetings and decision forums, keeping teams aligned on priorities, risks, and decisions
* Provide clear, concise project status reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership
* Surface risks early, manage trade-offs, and recommend options
* Document key decisions, scope changes, and acceptance criteria

Execution

* Manage scope, budget, risk, and dependencies across teams with competing priorities
* Monitor the change control process and track progress against the plan
* Confirm readiness at major milestones, including testing, UAT, and go-live
* Coordinate issue resolution across internal teams, vendors, and clients
* Maintain momentum and accountability without adding unnecessary process or overhead

Collaboration

* Partner with functional managers, business owners, project managers, and technical leads
* Network with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise
* May act as a team lead, coordinating the activities of other project contributors
* Foster strong working relationships across matrixed teams and external partners

Qualifications:

* Minimum 5 years of related experience managing distinct projects end-to-end
* A full understanding of project management discipline with demonstrated ability to resolve a wide range of issues
* Demonstrated experience operating in matrixed environments with multiple stakeholders
* Strong command of Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid delivery methodologies
* Proven ability to manage scope, risk, dependencies, and change effectively
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including status reporting to senior stakeholders
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, or a related field
* PMP certification

Preferred

* Postgraduate coursework
* Experience in SaaS or technology-enabled services environments, ideally within healthcare, insurance, or workers’ compensation
* Familiarity with tools such as Confluence, Wrike, Azure DevOps, MS Project, SharePoint, or Salesforce

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $80,500 - $105,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

The client seeks a highly experienced individual to serve as the Child Care Systems Modernization Implementation Manager. This individual will provide strategic guidance and direct execution during the planning, procurement, and implementation phases of a multi-year child care systems modernization initiative with a SaaS vendor.
  
  
The Implementation Manager will be responsible for ensuring IT leadership and stakeholders stay informed at all points of the transformation effort while working closely with the business area Strategic Consultant and the SaaS vendor’s Project Manager to ensure all parties involved remain aligned. The Implementation Manager will assist in defining scope, coordinating stakeholders, developing roadmaps, managing SaaS vendor engagements, and coordinating IT resources as well as leveraging established governance, planning, and operational structures to ensure successful implementation.
  
  
The selected contractor will operate with a high degree of independence and will leverage existing client subject matter experts, business leaders, and technology staff to advance the initiative.
  
  
The contractor will be expected to directly produce work products and deliverables rather than relying on dedicated project staff. Success in this role requires both strategic management and direct execution.
  
  
Project management certification or successful completion of a recognized project management curriculum is required
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Planning and Modernization Leadership
  
Coordinate with the Strategic Consultant to develop and maintain an overall modernization roadmap and implementation strategy.
  
Assess current-state business needs, technology systems, organizational readiness, and modernization needs.
  
Identify risks, dependencies, and critical decision points requiring executive engagement.
  
Recommend phased approaches for implementation, organizational change management, and business transformation.
  
Create roadmaps to layout when phases of the modernization effort should occur to ensure integrations are not missed and normal business operations are not negatively impacted.
  
Coordinate decommissioning of legacy apps and interfaces.
  
  
Procurement and Vendor Management
  
Collaborate in the development of procurement strategies and supporting documentation.
  
Draft and coordinate Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and related procurement materials.
  
Evaluate vendor proposals and support contract negotiations.
  
Advise client leadership on vendor selection, contracting approaches, and governance structures.
  
Establish performance expectations and accountability measures for future vendors and implementation partners.
  
Manage vendor relationships and monitor vendor performance to ensure adherence to contract requirements and expected outcomes.
  
  
Partner Coordination and Governance
  
Coordinate activities across business, policy, finance, procurement, and technology teams.
  
Facilitate executive decision-making and ensure alignment among partners and stakeholders.
  
Develop governance structures, decision frameworks, reporting processes, and escalation protocols.
  
Prepare executive briefings, status reports, and strategic recommendations.
  
Collaborate with cross functional partners within the client as well as other client agencies to coordinate shared resources.
  
  
Program Development and Readiness
  
Identify resource needs and recommend future staffing and contractor support models.
  
Develop foundational project artifacts, including charters, workplans, risk registers, issue logs, and implementation frameworks.
  
Support development of business requirements, process improvement opportunities, and future-state operating models.
  
Establish structures necessary for transition from planning into implementation.
  
Manage projects through the normal Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  
Create recommendations for leadership to improve standards, processes, and procedures.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
Within the first 12 months, the Implementation Manager will establish the strategic, procurement, governance, and operational foundations necessary to launch the child care modernization program and transition into full implementation with selected vendors and project teams. Within the first 18 months, the first phase of implementation will be successfully delivered.
  
  
Minimal Qualifications
  
Significant experience leading large-scale technology modernization or digital transformation initiatives with a SaaS vendor.
  
Demonstrated experience developing and managing complex technology procurements.
  
Experience with vendor selection, contract negotiation, and multi-vendor environments.
  
Strong knowledge of project management, organizational change management, and systems implementation methodologies.
  
Experience facilitating executive-level decision-making and stakeholder engagement.
  
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience with government program systems.
  
Experience modernizing legacy systems to a SaaS platform.
  
Solid understanding of cloud-based platforms, modular procurement strategies, and agile delivery approaches.
  
Experience coordinating between internal teams and SaaS vendors.
  
Experience establishing governance structures for large-scale modernization initiatives.
  
  
Qualification - Minimum Experience
  
Project Management of Large Initiatives - 15
  
Development of Project Artifacts (plan, charter, status reports, etc.) - 15
  
Procurement Planning - 10
  
Prepare Written Reports - 12
  
Strong Communication Skills - 12

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Implementation Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for leading the successful deployment of icobrain at customer sites across the U.S. and Canada, from project kickoff through go-live and handoff to ongoing support.  
This is a newly created role, added to support the continued growth of icobrain within GE HealthCare MR. The successful candidate will join the existing icobrain Implementation Specialist in USCAN, sharing the customer implementation workload and helping to strengthen and scale how implementations are delivered.  
  
This role sits at the intersection of technology and clinical workflow. The successful candidate will plan and execute technical software implementations, connecting icobrain's cloud-based platform with customer MR scanners, PACS, and RIS environments through DICOM and HL7, while making sure each deployment fits the way the customer's MR department works day to day.  
The role operates within a matrixed organization, reporting into GE HealthCare MR while dedicated specifically to icobrain. The Implementation Specialist will partner closely with their fellow icobrain Implementation Specialist, MR Sales, the Clinical AI Sales Specialist, Customer Success, icometrix product and support teams, GE HealthCare service and IT/security teams, and customer stakeholders. Across all of these relationships, the customer always comes first.  
  
Because icobrain is a growing part of the GE HealthCare MR portfolio, this role will also help formulate and document the implementation process itself, building the repeatable workflows, playbooks, and standards that allow the team to scale.  
This is a primarily remote role, with most implementation activity, including kickoffs, configuration, testing, and customer meetings, conducted virtually through phone and Microsoft Teams. Travel to customer sites will be required as needed for key milestones such as go-lives, workflow assessments, and escalations.  
  
The ideal candidate brings a client-first mindset to every interaction and is self-motivated, proactive, and highly organized, someone who takes control of issues and is eager to drive them to resolution.

* **Integrate icobrain into the customer environment:** Configure and validate DICOM connectivity and routing between MR scanners, PACS, and the icobrain cloud platform, and support HL7 interfaces and RIS integration for orders and results as required.
* **Align the solution with MR department workflow:** Work with MR technologists, radiologists, neuroradiologists, and imaging leaders to understand current workflows, protocols, and reading practices, and configure icobrain to fit seamlessly into them.

* **Build relationships, internally and externally:** Develop trusted relationships with customer clinical, IT, and administrative stakeholders and with GE HealthCare MR Sales, Clinical AI Sales, Customer Success, service, and product teams, always keeping the customer's needs at the center.
* **Manage multiple projects with discipline:** Track milestones, risks, actions, and documentation in established tools, and provide clear, timely status updates to customers and internal leadership.
* **Support existing customers and contract transitions:** Partner with Customer Success on reconfigurations, upgrades, site expansions, and the technical aspects of transitioning legacy icometrix customers to GE HealthCare agreements.
* **Bring the voice of the customer back to the organization:** Share implementation insights, recurring technical issues, and customer feedback with Product, Customer Success, and MR leadership to improve both the product and the implementation experience.

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of experience leading technical software implementations, ideally in healthcare IT, medical imaging, clinical software, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of **cloud applications** and SaaS deployment models, including connectivity, gateways, and cloud security considerations.
* Solid understanding of **DICOM and HL7 fundamentals**, such as DICOM routing, AE titles, and modality worklists, and HL7 order and result messaging.
* Understanding of **RIS and PACS** systems and how they interact within radiology workflow.
* Knowledge of **healthcare IT security and privacy**, including network security, access controls, security questionnaires, and HIPAA.
