The name says it: Well, for well-being and better care for all. Hive, for a community of people working together to solve complex problems. Our team is smart, humble, focused, and collaborative, and we keep moving forward no matter the obstacles.

Position Summary

WellHive supports the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) through the Enterprise Patient

Scheduling (EPS) program, helping Veterans get scheduled for the care they need and deserve. The Training Project Manager owns the planning and execution of training for pilot sites and the plan for national release of WellHive, and stays accountable for scheduler adoption through hypercare and beyond.

You will lead a training project team of WellHive employees and subcontractors, manage the

relationship with the Lead System Integrator (LSI), and oversee Solution Engineer work on Change Requests that come out of training and hypercare. You will partner with Release Management and testers so trainers and users always know what is coming and what has shipped. You are the face of WellHive to schedulers, Scheduling Supervisors, and VA Medical Center leadership during on-site training and post-go-live support, with a steady focus on raising adoption of the WellHive platform.

Key Responsibilities

Training Planning & Delivery

* Manage program and project activities, including scope, requirements, timelines, and communication plans with the customer.
* Manage a training calendar visible to all WellHive employees involved in training.
* Deliver customer-centric training, virtual and in-person, that prioritizes user adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Develop a customized training plan for VHA Integration Scheduling pilot testing and national rollout.
* Create and maintain a Training SOP for current and future implementations.
* Create training materials for demos, virtual and on-site training, and FAQs.
* Learn new features and train the trainers ahead of Pilot or General Availability releases.
* Hypercare Management & Oversight
* Manage and oversee hypercare for each pilot and rollout site, including staffing, coverage, escalation paths, and exit criteria.
* Triage and track hypercare issues, coordinate resolution with the right teams, and keep site leadership informed.

As a family-oriented company, we embrace a "No Jerk Zone," fostering an environment of respect, support, and teamwork at every level. **Job Description**

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing commercial reroofing and new construction roofing projects from initiation to completion. Your expertise in project management, strong organizational skills, and commitment to delivering high-quality results will ensure projects are executed efficiently while meeting client and general contractor expectations, budget requirements, and schedule commitments.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning and Execution:**

* Collaborate with clients, general contractors, sales, estimators, and internal teams during the pre-construction phase to understand project requirements, scope of work, and budget.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, including detailed schedules, budgets, and resource allocation.
* Manage multiple reroofing and new construction projects simultaneously, ensuring adherence to project timelines and contractual requirements.

* Conduct regular site visits and inspections to monitor progress, quality, and safety compliance.

**2. Budget and Cost Management:**

* Develop and manage project budgets, tracking labor, materials, and subcontractor costs.
* Review and approve project-related invoices, purchase orders, and change orders in accordance with company processes.
* Monitor project financial performance, identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
* Collaborate with the accounting and finance teams to ensure accurate billing, forecasting, and financial reporting.

**3. Client and Stakeholder Relationship Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, general contractors, and project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide regular updates on project progress, keeping stakeholders informed of milestones, schedules, and any changes.
* Address client concerns or issues promptly to ensure satisfaction and successful project delivery.
* Maintain strong client relationships, addressing any post-project needs or inquiries.

**4. Team Collaboration and Leadership:**

* Coordinate and collaborate with superintendents, project administrators, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure seamless project workflow.
* Provide clear instructions and guidance to project team members, setting expectations and objectives.
* Foster a collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, communication, and accountability.
* Facilitate effective communication and coordination among all project stakeholders.

**5. Quality Control and Safety Compliance:**

* Implement and enforce quality control measures to ensure adherence to project specifications, manufacturer requirements, and industry standards.
* Conduct regular inspections to monitor workmanship and materials, addressing any quality concerns promptly.
* Collaborate with the safety team to enforce safety protocols, ensuring a safe work environment for all project participants.

**6. Additional Responsibilities:**

* Handle additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in commercial roofing or commercial construction project management.
* Experience with both reroofing and new construction projects is a plus.
* Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering multiple projects on time and within budget.
* Solid knowledge of roofing systems, materials, and installation techniques.
* Strong knowledge of construction project management processes and documentation.

* Team player attitude is a must.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Project Manager

30 Lines is a digital marketing agency built for the multifamily industry. We run the websites, search, advertising and lead nurturing behind hundreds of apartment communities across the country, and we have been doing it long enough to know the difference between marketing that looks good in a report and marketing that fills apartments.

**At a glance**
---------------

* **Schedule:** Full-time, salaried (exempt)

**What you'll do**

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
#### **About the role**

Roasters, cafes and producers know their coffee. As a **Customer Success Manager**, you help them run the business around it: onboarding, adoption, renewals and growth. Cropster keeps 95% of its customers after 15 years. You help us keep it that way, one relationship at a time.  
  
You listen first, understand what each customer is trying to achieve, and show how Cropster gets them there. You manage your portfolio independently, and you work with Product, Marketing and Support when a customer needs more than one person can give.  
This is a fully remote role. For optimal team collaboration across global time zones, you regularly work flexibly in US Eastern or Central time hours, so you overlap with customers and the team.

#### **What you'll do**

**Look after your customer portfolio**

* Know where every account stands: priorities, risks, renewals and growth opportunities.
* Balance onboarding, trials, renewals, billing questions, support issues and commercial opportunities, and ask for help early when priorities collide.
* Keep CRM records current: interactions, account health and next steps.

**Help customers adopt Cropster and stay**

* Guide customers from trial through onboarding with clear next steps and regular contact.
* Hold regular check-ins to connect product features to customer goals, and follow up on every open action.
* Watch engagement and adoption to spot churn risks early, and talk about them openly with the customer.
* Lead discovery calls and product demos with existing accounts.

**Grow accounts**

* Spot expansion, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, including added services and subscription upgrades, and follow them through.
* Reach out to inactive customers and rebuild the relationship.
* Analyze account performance and give customers practical recommendations.
* Work towards agreed targets for retention, expansion revenue, outreach and pipeline, with a clear status and next step for every opportunity.

**Work together**

* Bring customer feedback and feature requests to Product and Marketing.
* Work with colleagues across teams so customers hear one answer, not three.

**What success looks like**

* Customers hear from you proactively and get timely follow-up.
* Trials, onboarding and commercial opportunities always have a next step.
* You know the health, risks, renewals and growth opportunities across your portfolio.
* Your pipeline and CRM data are accurate.
* You keep your commitments and show progress against agreed retention and revenue targets.

#### **We are looking for someone with**

* A degree in business, marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience in Customer Success.
* Several years in Customer Success or customer service, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a record of improving retention and satisfaction.
* Experience managing a high-volume portfolio while keeping contact consistent.
* Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish, written and spoken. Portuguese is a plus.
* Clear, concise communication and real care for your customer’s outcome.
* Commercial awareness: you notice risks and revenue opportunities and follow them through.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing tasks.
* Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Initiative and follow-through, and openness about where you need support.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* The ability to adapt when priorities change.

#### **That said, we’d be particularly delighted to hire someone with**

* Experience in the coffee industry, or familiarity with Cropster’s products or market.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* An understanding of technical SaaS products and subscription models.
* Availability for occasional travel to industry events and customer visits (15-20%). If travel is difficult for you, tell us and we’ll talk.

You don’t need to tick every box. If this role sounds like you, apply. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion or background. If you need adjustments during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll arrange them.

#### **What you can expect**

The base salary range for this position is **$70K to $80K USD gross base/year** + 20% variable compensation potential. We look at factors like your experience, location and individual qualifications to determine our offer. Additional benefits include medical, dental and vision health plans, employer-provided HRA, 401k with employer contribution, budgets for education & wellbeing, and professional development, a co-working benefit to support remote work, very flexible working hours without core hours, paid time for volunteer work, access to mental health support, and discounts for really great coffee. We also make our best possible offer upfront - no games!  
  
**Hiring timeline**: We are starting the interview process now and aim to hire by mid-January 2027. Interested but concerned about the timeline, apply and leave a note

#### **Apply now**

We look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact our team at jobs@cropster.com.  
  
This position is open for immediate hire. Currently, Cropster will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the US for this opening.

#### **About us**

Cropster is a team of coffee enthusiasts. We build the platform that connects coffee workflows from bean to cup.

As a Certified B Corp™, we work to make coffee more sustainable, transparent, and community-driven, and to amplify our positive impact along the way.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Mid-Market
jobs.description:

Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. ### **Role Overview:**

The Account Management (AM) Mid-Market role is newer within the Customer Success organization at Apollo.io. * **Close Incremental Business Opportunities:** Identify and close expansion opportunities within Tier 1/Tier 2 Mid Market accounts.

* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally:** Work closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

### **Core Competencies:**

* Customer-Centric Mentality: Balance customer needs with business objectives.
* Product Aptitude: Enthusiastically explore product capabilities to drive usage and adoption.
* Revenue Mindset: Proven ability to generate pipeline and close revenue through upsell, cross-sell, and upgrades.
* Curiosity: Eagerness to learn about sales tech, customer business models, and industry trends.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with internal teams to achieve mutual success.

### **Qualifications:**

* 4-5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, preferably in product-led growth environments.
* Proven track record of consistently meeting monthly or quarterly revenue targets.
* Experience in developing a 3x pipeline through a blend of inbound leads and targeted account planning.
* Comfortable identifying additional use cases and expansion opportunities.
* Experience working cross-functionally with customer success, support, marketing, legal, and product teams.

### **Goals & Activity Expectations:**

* **Achieve Monthly Revenue Targets**: Consistently meet or exceed monthly revenue targets as a fully-ramped account manager.

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We're on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

At Apollo, we're driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That's why we **take extreme ownership** of our work, **move with focus and urgency**, and **learn voraciously** to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to **own your role and make a real impact**. Collaboration is at our core—we're **all for one**, meaning you'll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage **bold ideas and courageous action**, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you're looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. **Job Title:** AI Enablement Lead  
**Location:** Chicago/Remote, USA  
**Work Schedule:** Monday – Friday, standard business hours, with some early-morning or evening meetings across time zones

**Job Summary:**
----------------

The AI Enablement Lead helps Opensity Solutions put AI to work safely and effectively. This person trains and coaches employees at every skill level, builds practical apps and automations, and keeps all AI use within the AI Acceptable Use Policy.

Opensity is a global managed services provider serving law firms, financial services organizations, and other highly regulated clients. This hands-on individual contributor role reports to the VP of IT and works closely with Information Security, the Data Governance Board, HR, Legal, and Executive Leadership Team sponsors.

**Backgrounds That Fit This Role:**

Strong candidates often hold roles like these and bring advanced, self-directed generative AI skills:

* Corporate trainer or learning and development specialist
* Change management or digital adoption lead
* Technical trainer or customer success engineer at a software company
* Citizen developer or power user (Power Automate, Power BI, ChatGPT)
* IT service management or knowledge management professional

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Enablement and Adoption**

* Lead the company-wide AI adoption program: role-based training, new user onboarding, and an AI champions network.
* Coach employees at every comfort level through live training, demos, office hours, and one-on-one support.
* Partner with Executive Leadership Team sponsors to identify use cases and build the apps, workflows, and automations that deliver them.
* Publish and maintain guidance on when to use Claude versus Microsoft Copilot.
* Build adoption plans for seat holders whose usage falls below expectations.

**Governance**

* Run AI tool intake and review with Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement before any tool or integration goes live.
* Manage the Claude and Copilot license lifecycle, from sponsor approval through training and policy acknowledgment.
* Maintain the AI tool inventory and approved use case register.
* Represent IT on AI matters at the Data Governance Board.

**Compliance**

* Keep AI use consistent with the AI Acceptable Use Policy, Employee Handbook, and client contracts.
* Coordinate high-risk use case reviews and confirm written approvals before work begins, including HR and Legal approval for any use touching employment decisions.
* Support Information Security with AI evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and client audits.

**Reporting**

* Run the quarterly AI usage audit against Executive Leadership Team thresholds.
* Maintain dashboards on adoption, usage, spend, and policy exceptions.
* Report AI value in hours saved and cost avoided, with monthly updates to IT leadership and quarterly summaries for the Executive Leadership Team.

**What Success Looks Like**

* 90 days: AI tool inventory complete; license and audit process running; first usage report delivered.
* 6 months: Claude and Copilot guidance published; champions active in every business unit; 10 or more documented use cases with measured time savings.
* 1 year: AI audit evidence ready; utilization above target for most seats; AI value included in the IT business case.

* 5 or more years in IT, technology enablement, change management, or adoption roles, including at least 1 year hands-on with generative AI or automation tools.
* Experience deploying enterprise AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or ChatGPT Enterprise.
* A portfolio of apps, automations, or agents built with AI tools or Power Platform.
* Patience and skill teaching non-technical and skeptical users.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and data protection basics.
* Experience working within governance and approval processes.
* Clear writer and presenter for audiences from frontline staff to executives.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Managed services provider (MSP) experience.
* Experience in legal, financial services, or other confidentiality-driven environments.
* Experience building agents, skills, connectors, or MCP integrations.
* Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, or ISO/IEC 42001.
* Certifications such as Prosci, IAPP AIGP, or Microsoft Azure AI Engineer.

**Working Conditions**

* Some early-morning or evening meetings with international teams, including the Philippines.
* Occasional travel, up to 10%.
* Remote work requires Company approval and Company-issued equipment.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunities for growth and learning in an IT career path.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Office Manager serves as the administrative coordination hub for the Executive Director and Director of Operations. This high-trust role manages calendars, leadership follow-up, meeting preparation, document organization, internal communications, office systems and cross-department project tracking. The position anticipates deadlines, brings outstanding items to leadership’s attention and helps ensure decisions are translated into assigned, documented and completed next steps. The Office Manager coordinates work but does not independently make trustee, legal, personnel or financial approval decisions.

Executive Leadership & Calendar Support

· Manage and prioritize executive calendars, meeting invitations, scheduling conflicts, agendas, reminders and follow-up deadlines for the Executive Director and Director of Operations.

· Provide high-level administrative and organizational support to the Executive Director and Director of Operations, ensuring leadership priorities, projects, and operational responsibilities remain organized and on schedule.

· Develop and maintain a centralized leadership tracking system identifying key priorities, assigned owners, deadlines, project statuses, dependencies, outstanding deliverables, and matters requiring escalation.

· Proactively monitor deadlines, identify potential delays, follow up with responsible team members, and escalate unresolved matters to the appropriate leadership personnel.

· Prepare concise weekly executive summaries highlighting completed initiatives, upcoming deadlines, outstanding action items, operational concerns, and decisions requiring leadership attention.

· Assist leadership in prioritizing competing responsibilities and maintaining accountability across departments.

· Prepare meeting briefs, talking points, presentations, correspondence and organized background materials for leadership review.

· Coordinate leadership travel, conferences, appointments and related logistics within approved budgets and policies.

· Protect confidential executive, personnel, Board and beneficiary information; route sensitive decisions to authorized leaders.

Board Governance & Executive Meetings

· Coordinate Board and committee meeting calendars, invitations, agenda drafts, document collection, presentation assembly and timely distribution of approved materials.

· Organize Board portal materials and version control; track requested follow-up items and approved action deadlines.

· Collaborate with the Director of Operations to plan, organize, and coordinate CPT Institute’s annual Board Retreat, including scheduling, logistics, agendas, meeting materials, accommodations, and communication with Board Members.

· Assist with documenting retreat discussions, action items, and follow-up responsibilities to ensure organizational priorities and Board directives are communicated and implemented.

· Assist with meeting minutes and action summaries when assigned, subject to leadership review and approval.

· Prepare meeting agendas in advance, gather departmental updates, and ensure leadership has the necessary information to conduct productive meetings.

· Maintain an annual governance and reporting calendar for recurring meetings, approvals and administrative deadlines.

Operations & Project Coordination

· Coordinate cross-functional projects for the Director of Operations, maintaining timelines, task owners, milestone dashboards and follow-up reminders.

· Monitor outstanding operational requests and identify bottlenecks, overdue tasks or items requiring management attention.

· Organize standard operating procedures, templates, internal forms and shared reference materials; coordinate updates approved by department leaders.

· Compile accurate operational KPIs and status reports from designated data owners without independently certifying underlying financial or trust data.

· Help streamline internal workflows, handoffs, documentation standards and recurring administrative processes.

Nonprofit Trustee Administrative Support

· Coordinate secure collection, routing, filing and tracking of trust-related administrative documents at the direction of authorized trust administration staff.

· Assist with document checklists, signature logistics, correspondence and deadline reminders; escalate incomplete or time-sensitive items.

· Coordinate with Trust Administration, Finance, legal counsel and external partners on scheduling and administrative follow-up, without offering legal or benefits advice.

· Follow confidentiality, record retention, access-control and information-security procedures for beneficiary and organizational records.

Office Administration, Vendors & Technology

· Oversee day-to-day administrative workflows, office supplies, equipment, mail routing and vendor service requests.

· Maintain organized electronic filing, document naming conventions and access permissions in collaboration with system owners.

· Coordinate technology onboarding, equipment requests, software access changes and troubleshooting with authorized IT personnel.

· Track routine vendor renewals, invoices and service issues for review by the appropriate approver; do not independently commit funds beyond delegated authority.

**Departmental Meeting Oversight and Accountability**

· Coordinate with department leaders to ensure all CPT Institute departments conduct regularly scheduled team meetings to maintain communication, accountability, and operational consistency.

· Establish and maintain a centralized schedule of departmental meetings, ensuring appropriate meeting frequency and participation.

· Monitor the timely submission of weekly departmental reports to the Executive Director and Director of Operations.

· Assist in standardizing departmental reporting formats to include accomplishments, key performance indicators (KPIs), pending assignments, operational challenges, staffing concerns, and upcoming priorities.

**About Remote Legal**

At Remote Legal, our 40-year legacy is built on the expertise of seasoned attorneys and dedicated court reporters who are passionate about transforming the legal process. We're not a flash-in-the-pan tech startup—instead, we blend time-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone.

**About the role**

The Reporter Training Specialist- Testimony Capture is responsible for sourcing, onboarding, and training court reporters within the Testimony Capture department. This role helps design and maintain training programs, documentation, and quality standards to ensure reporters are fully prepared to deliver high-quality services. Works cross-functionally with Operations, Assignments, Production, and Customer Support to support reporter readiness, platform proficiency, and ongoing performance.

**What you'll do**

* Sources court reporters through approved recruiting platforms, including Rippling
* Conducts interviews, evaluates qualifications, and supports hiring decisions for reporters
* Manages onboarding process, including documentation, system access, and initial readiness checks
* Trains reporters on company processes, operational expectations, and quality standards
* Delivers training on Remote Legal platforms and related technology tools
* Creates, maintains, and updates training scenarios, guides, and reference materials
* Develops procedures and training documentation to support consistency and quality across reporting team
* Coordinates with Operations and Assignments to identify training needs and performance gaps
* Provides refresher training, updates, and process rollouts as procedures evolve
* Supports remediation and targeted retraining when quality or compliance issues are identified
* Maintains accurate training records and onboarding documentation for reporters
* Monitors training effectiveness and recommends improvements based on feedback and outcomes
* Ensures training aligns with legal, procedural, and company standards
* Develop, review, and update the quality rubric to ensure alignment with company standards
* Establish and enforce a consistent cadence for feedback
* Facilitate and lead regular quality calibration sessions
* Create and distribute detailed feedback based on quality reviews and audits
* Review markups and scorecards prepared by others for accuracy and consistency
* Maintains strict confidentiality of all company, client, and reporter information
* Recruits, onboards, trains, and oversees direct reports as assigned; provides coaching, guidance, and development
* Sets team priorities, allocates workload, and ensures coverage for onboarding, training delivery, and quality reviews
* Leads performance management activities for direct reports, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, documentation, and support for corrective action when needed
* Establishes repeatable team workflows, documentation standards, and knowledge-sharing routines to support consistent delivery and coverage
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* Strong training, facilitation, and instructional design skills
* Ability to clearly communicate processes and technical concepts
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding and training workflows simultaneously
* High attention to detail and quality standards
* Problem-solving mindset with ability to adapt training to reporter needs
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop team members in a remote environment
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, remote environment
* Experience with court reporting workflows or legal proceedings preferred
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with multiple departments

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience).
* 2-5 years of professional experience, including:

o Experience in training, onboarding, operations, or related roles

o Experience in legal, court reporting, or related environments

**W****ork Environment**

* This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.
* All work is conducted through secure, company-approved technology platforms via computer, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
* Reliable high-speed internet access and a private, secure workspace are required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods at a computer workstation in a remote, home-based environment.
* Ability to perform repetitive motions, including frequent typing, keyboarding, and use of a mouse or other input devices.
* Ability to view computer screens, read digital documents, and analyze information for prolonged periods.
* Ability to occasionally adjust or move home office equipment weighing up to 10 pounds
* Some evening or weekend work may be required depending on client needs or emergency situations.
* Ability to travel to surrounding areas or states as needed.

**The Opportunity:**  
We are seeking an experienced Instructional Designer (consultant) to support enterprise-wide training development, workforce transformation and technology adoption initiatives within the JTMS program.

Virtual Training: Create simulation training, microlearning videos, knowledge-check quizzes, and web-based courses using specialized business applications.
  
Training Systems Support: Define data sets required to perform exercises in an SAP training instance, including the creation, maintenance and management of data sheets.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About The Princeton Review**

The Princeton Review is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of college- and graduate school–bound students achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company's Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 22 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

**About the Position**

We're looking for a detail-obsessed, quick-learning Revenue Operations Specialist to join our remote team and keep our revenue data accurate, visible, and actionable. In this role, you'll track and forecast revenue across accounts, reconcile records with Accounting, and manage revenue data in Salesforce. You'll also guide Sales and Customer Success toward the highest-priority accounts to close each month.

Day to day, you'll write Standard Operating Procedures, audit internal systems, and work with teams across the company (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Accounts Receivable, and senior leadership) to resolve invoicing questions quickly and accurately. You'll also take on special projects, including building a new invoicing process in Salesforce, managing non-standard contract compliance, serving as the Sales and Marketing liaison on lead list management and CCPA compliance, and helping launch new Sales Enablement tools such as a Sales Playbook on SharePoint.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify and track all potential revenue earnings for each account, report to Leadership weekly, and reconcile records with Accounting monthly.
* Guide the Sales and Customer Success teams to maximize impact on revenue by identifying high priority accounts to close each month.
* Design and write Standard Operating Procedures when needed to improve accuracy, efficiency, and usability for internal teams.
* Coordinate with multiple internal teams to ensure quick and accurate response to customer inquiries regarding invoicing.
* Verify and input sales credits and debits into our internal tools to guarantee customer account balances as displayed accessible and accurate for our clients.
* Audit data entries and program statuses in our internal systems.
* Effectively communicate system needs to Salesforce Administrator and Sales Operations leadership to support design of technological tools that will improve workflow for business unit.
* Design and maintain a new invoicing process that bridges information in our proprietary Customer Service Tool and Salesforce.
* Manage non-standard contract compliance and reporting, using Claude AI and Salesforce to identify and track requirements.
* Serve as a liaison between Sales and Marketing regarding lead list management and sales follow-through.
* Write, build, and maintain the Sales Playbook on SharePoint.

**Who You Are**

* 3-5 years of Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales experience, preferably in B2B SaaS
* Extremely detail oriented, prone to checking every last number and data point
* Ability to quickly learn new concepts and systems.
* Adept at using Excel for data entry, data preparation and some data analysis: pivot tables, vlookups, sumifs are all important to this position
* Knowledgeable of general accounting principles related to deferred revenue calculations and reporting
* Comfortable running reports in Salesforce Lightning and navigating the Salesforce environment.
* SharePoint experience preferred
* Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude to improve efficiencies in workflow
* Ability to interface professionally and effectively with many personality types from various departments including senior management, sales and service, marketing, legal team, and accounts receivables
* Work quickly, independently and remotely with an ability to adapt to changes in priority as needed
* Collaborate with, support, and lean on teammates when needed
* Willing to put in extra time during our busiest season with the understanding that flexibility will be reciprocated

*The Princeton Review is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Princeton Review's policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. The Princeton Review also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. **Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives!**

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **Oakland, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 20 hours per week
* **Job Location:** Oakland, CA
* **Pay rate:** $21.00/hr

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**About us**

LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.

**Our Benefits**

In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program

Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off

**About Swords to Plowshares**

Founded in 1974, Swords to Plowshares is a community-based not-for-profit organization that provides counseling and case management, employment and training, housing, and legal assistance to veterans in the San Francisco Bay Area. We promote and protect the rights of veterans through advocacy, public education, and partnerships with local, state, and national entities. Believing that war causes wounds and suffering that last beyond the battlefield, our mission is to support veterans as they navigate the challenges of post-military life, and to prevent and end veteran homelessness through wrap-around care and informed advocacy. To learn more about Swords to Plowshares, please visit our website at www.swords-to-plowshares.org .

**Job Title:** SSVF Case Manager, East Bay

**Location:** 330 Franklin St. Suite 100, Oakland, CA 94607

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday; 9:00 am -5:00pm

**Reporting Type:** In-person

**Employment Type:** Full-time, non-exempt

**Salary Range:** $30.77

**Summary Of Position**

The Case Manager will work in collaboration with the SSVF Program Team and Drop-In Program staff to identify appropriate permanent housing and/or eviction prevention interventions for veterans enrolled in the program. The Case Manager will provide case management services to veteran households transitioning into permanent housing, as well as those at risk of losing their housing. Utilizing evidence-based best practices, the Case Manager will assess, enroll, and refer veterans to permanent housing and transitional placement services, or assist veteran families with homelessness prevention services.

The Case Manager will develop and maintain community partnerships with Supportive Housing Programs, the VA VASH Voucher Program, and market-rate landlords to expand housing opportunities and strengthen eviction prevention efforts. They will work to ensure a smooth transition into permanent housing and maintain supportive relationships with veterans to promote long-term housing stability within the community. This role also includes serving as a resource for staff regarding housing placements and housing applications.

This position reports to the SSVF Program Managers and/or SSVF Program Coordinators and Program Director.

· Perform intakes and assessments to determine program eligibility and place program participants into permanent housing; coordinate eviction prevention services; review and update individualized Housing Stability Plans as needed.

· Maintain case management functions, including record keeping and client services.

· Refer and connect veteran clients with supportive services and community resources.

· Enter and maintain HMIS, ETO, and ECS data and client records.

· Conduct both in-person and remote housing inspections throughout San Francisco, Alameda, San Mateo, Contra Costa, and Marin Counties.

· Maintain a working understanding of veteran readjustment challenges, including Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI), alcohol and drug dependency, and other mental health conditions by attending trainings and utilizing resources offered by the SSVF leadership team.

· Adhere to laws regarding confidentiality and reporting requirements; maintain knowledge of current HIPAA policies and procedures.

· Assist veteran households with money management and budgeting as needed.

· Assist veterans with establishing disability income and accessing other eligible benefits as needed.

**About the Company:**

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

**About the team**

The People team is the engine behind World’s most important asset: its people. We build, support, and scale a global organization of exceptional talent. We design experiences that attract world-class builders and retain, recognize, reward, and enable them to do the best work of their lives.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a People Operations Manager to shape how employees and managers experience working at World, from onboarding through major career and life changes. You’ll own how our core People programs run today and help shape where we invest next. You’ll use employee feedback, support trends, and your own experience handling complex cases to set priorities, bring the right partners together, and see improvements through rollout. Success means employees can get routine things done easily and count on thoughtful, accurate support when the stakes are high.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead day-to-day operations across onboarding, mobility, benefits, compensation, and sensitive organizational changes. Handle complex requests from intake through resolution, keeping employees and managers informed along the way
* Use employee feedback and support trends to spot where people get stuck. Recommend what to fix first, make the change, and check whether it reduced delays or repeat questions
* Keep employee data accurate. Run regular audits, resolve discrepancies, and fix the underlying process when the same errors recur
* Make workflows easier to run as volume grows. Simplify handoffs, automate repetitive steps, and give the team clear guidance for handling exceptions

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* The ability to break a process down into its core components and identify the root causes for gaps or inefficiencies
* Strong operational judgment and experience handling sensitive, time-critical employee matters with precision, empathy, and clear written communication
* Hands-on experience maintaining accurate employee data and building reports in an HR system, ideally Workday, along with experience automating repetitive workflows using tools such as Google Apps Script, Python, or SQL
* Proven cross-functional influence - bringing Legal, Finance, and People stakeholders together to resolve ambiguity and move decisions forward
* An appetite for the day-to-day work of People Operations, from personally guiding an employee through a difficult case to improving the process for the next person

*Pay transparency statement (for CA and NY based roles):*

*The reasonably estimated salary for this role at TFH ranges from* ***$203,000 - $225,000****, plus a competitive long term incentive package. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, TFH offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) plan and match, life insurance, flexible time off, commuter benefits, professional development stipend and much more!*

Hardware

  

Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.
  
  
This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.
  
  
Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

We are seeking a Trade Compliance Operations Manager to support the Global Operations team in keeping Cerebras’ international shipments compliant with import and export requirements. This role owns the operational side of trade compliance, including customs documentation, jurisdiction and classification, export controls, and regulatory record keeping, in a fast-paced hardware environment.

The Trade Compliance Operations Manager will prepare and review shipping documentation, maintain compliance trackers, work with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and internal teams, and improve compliance processes. The role connects closely with logistics, supply chain, warehouse, finance, and legal. It requires the ability to work quickly, understand enough about Cerebras’ technology and risk profile to ask the right questions, and bring structure to the company’s trade program.

**Key Responsibilities**

The Manager will manage day-to-day trade compliance operations, escalating compliance risks to the Global Operations and Trade Compliance leadership as needed.

* Prepare and review international shipping documents, such as commercial invoices, packing lists, and airway bills, for accuracy and completeness.

* Manage customs clearance activities by working with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and internal teams to resolve open documentation requests and holds.

* Maintain product classification records, including HTS and export control classification information, and resolve missing or inconsistent data.

* Run export control and restricted party screening processes, and track items that need review or approval before shipment.

* Maintain trade compliance trackers, such as license and permit status, shipment holds, duty and tariff items, and open compliance issues.

* Organize and retain import and export records in line with regulatory and company record keeping requirements.

* Document process steps and gaps, and drive improvements to trade compliance and export/customs execution.

* Coordinate with Logistics, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Finance, and Legal to close compliance-related open items.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, International Business, Logistics, Law, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 5+ years of experience in trade compliance, customs, import/export operations, or international logistics.

* Working knowledge of customs procedures, HTS classification, export controls, country of origin, and sanctions or restricted party screening.

* Familiar with ACE portal to monitor both Import & Export shipments.

* Familiarity with domestic and international trade programs and regimes such as duty drawback, CTPAT, or USMCA.

* Be the subject matter expert for current trade environment for tariffs, supporting sourcing teams to come up with sourcing strategies to mitigate tariffs and optimizing logistics costs at the same time.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to keep records, trackers, and documentation accurate and organized.

* Proficiency in Excel or similar tools to maintain trackers and produce reports. The ability to use AI to maintain and enhance such tasks is a plus.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with clear and prompt follow-up with internal teams, brokers, and logistics partners.

* Familiarity with implementing system controls related to trade compliance and ability to partner with IT, legal, engineering and other stakeholders for implementation. NetSuite experience preferred.

* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and follow established procedures.

**Location**: Sunnyvale, CA

The base salary range for this position is $190,000 to $230,000 annually. Actual compensation may include bonus and equity, and will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications.

**Why Join Cerebras**

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras:

* Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU.

* Publish and open source their cutting-edge AI research.

* Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world.

* Enjoy job stability with startup vitality.

* Our simple, non-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs.

  

**Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!**

*Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.*

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we've expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

  

**THE JOB**

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer's experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
* Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
* Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say "yes" to customer needs
* Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
* Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.
* Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
* Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
* Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet's care and strengthen relationships
* Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

  

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
* Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software
* Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
* A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
* A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos
* High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
* Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
* Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors
* Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs
* Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types
  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
* Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team's' accomplishments
* Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results
* Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

  

**HOW WE INVEST IN YOU**

* Competitive compensation: pay range is $20-$30 and based on experience, including base and 401K match
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling
* Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success
* A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.
* Clinical student loan repayment so you don't need to worry about your student debt
* Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families
* Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work
* Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people
* And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you're hungry

  

**DEI**

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is "Helping people and their pets when they need it most." And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture

new_jobs.title: Regional Quality Manager: Home Health
new_jobs.description:
**21st Century Home Health Services (21HHS)** is dedicated to delivering exceptional care to its patients while fostering a supportive and rewarding environment for its employees. The company consistently achieves hospital readmission rates below 10%—well under the industry average of more than 15%. It has also earned recognition as a 2024 Top Workplace, highlighting its culture of open communication, professional growth, empowerment, and appreciation.

As the fastest-growing home health agency in Northern California, 21HHS recently expanded into Marin and Sonoma counties, extending its reach while maintaining a reputation for excellence. Positive reviews across platforms such as Yelp, Google, Glassdoor, and Indeed reflect both the quality of care provided to patients and the outstanding experience of its employees, reinforcing its leadership in the home health industry.

We're looking for a Regional Quality Manager who's driven by outcomes: better patient care, stronger clinical practice, and a team that feels genuinely supported. You'll set the standard for how care gets delivered across your region — building systems that hold up in the field, not just on paper.

If you find satisfaction in spotting what's not working, coaching teams toward better ways of doing it, and building a culture where quality is everyone's job, we'd love to meet you.

  

*This is not a remote opportunity. The position requires you to be onsite at one of our local offices (Walnut Creek, San Jose, Burlingame, Sacramento)*

### **What You'll Do:**

### **Clinical Education & Readmission Prevention**

* Design and deliver targeted clinical education based on readmission data and the patterns behind it.
* Hold weekly office hours to coach clinicians on high-risk areas, including OASIS accuracy, discharge planning and patient education.
* Develop role-specific training curricula that address gaps found through readmission root cause analysis.
* Build and maintain a complete training library on our eLearning platform.
* Make sure all new hires complete their onboarding competencies and certifications on time.
* Manage the region's education calendar, choosing topics from real audit findings, incident trends and clinician feedback rather than a static annual checklist.

### **Quality Assurance & QAPI Leadership**

* Develop and oversee the regional Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, including its dashboards, audit tools, reporting cadence and committee structure.
* Track the metrics that matter: CMS Quality Measures, SHP KPIs, potentially avoidable events (PAEs), readmission and hospitalization rates, start-of-care timeliness, star ratings, patient satisfaction, and charting quality and timeliness.
* Run internal audits, chart reviews and field observations, then turn what you find into corrective action plans with measurable outcomes.
* Keep the region ready for external audits and accreditation reviews (CHAP, Kaiser) year-round instead of scrambling at the last minute.
* Standardize best practices across branches, replacing one-off workarounds with clear, repeatable processes clinicians can follow in the field.
* Investigate incidents, complaints and adverse events with a systems lens. Find what allowed the failure, not just who was involved, and put safeguards in place so it doesn't happen again.

### **Readmission Analysis & Readmission Nurse Coordination**

* Work directly with readmission nurses to analyze trends in readmissions, hospital transfers and PAEs.
* Make sure all readmission and PAE reports are complete, timely and clinically accurate.
* Train readmission nurses on root cause analysis methods and reporting procedures.
* Find the clinical competency gaps behind poor outcomes, design targeted interventions, and share patterns with clinical supervisors and educators.
* Coordinate readmission follow-ups and patient education to prevent repeat admissions.
* Report quarterly on readmission metrics and on how well education and interventions are working.

### **Overseas Concierge Oversight**

* Partner with outsourced overseas concierge managers to set quality standards and performance expectations.
* Review concierge call recordings and documentation for quality.
* Monitor concierge metrics, including call quality, documentation accuracy and adherence to escalation procedures.
* Make sure concierges are trained on 21st Century protocols and quality expectations, work with managers on improvement plans, and escalate significant issues to senior leadership.

### **Performance Improvement & Staff Development**

* Support clinical supervisors in putting performance improvement plans (PIPs) in place for clinicians with quality gaps, and track progress with documented outcomes.
* Coach clinicians through real-time feedback, competency assessments and targeted education that builds skill rather than just documenting it.
* Develop clinical supervisors so quality oversight is shared across the team instead of depending on you.
* Recommend professional development opportunities for clinical staff.
* Promote continuous learning and psychological safety, so staff raise concerns early and near-misses are treated as chances to learn.

### **Leadership & Partnership**

* Act as a working partner to regional and site leadership, not an outside auditor. Sit in on operations meetings, understand each location's constraints, and build improvement plans that fit how each team actually runs.
* Align quality goals with staffing, scheduling and growth plans, including new locations, service line expansion and system rollouts.
* Give senior leadership clear, honest updates on what's improving, what isn't, and what resources the region needs.
* Use patient and family concerns as a quality signal. Resolve them quickly, follow through personally, and turn complaint patterns into process changes.
* Share quality outcomes with external partners such as Kaiser, using performance data, star ratings and satisf

Genesis Surgical Arts is seeking an experienced, organized, and highly dependable **Medical Practice Office Manager** to oversee the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of our growing surgical practice.

This is a hands-on management position for someone who enjoys keeping a medical practice organized, solving problems, coordinating people and vendors, and making sure important details don't fall through the cracks.

The Office Manager will work closely with the physicians, clinical staff, surgery scheduler, care coordinator, billing team, patients, hospitals, vendors, and outside organizations.

**Schedule**

**Monday–Thursday:** 9:00 AM–4:00 PM  
**Friday:** 9:00 AM–1:00 PM  
**32 hours per week**

**What You'll Do**

* Oversee day-to-day administrative operations of the medical practice
* Manage physician schedules, calendars, conferences, meetings, and travel
* Coordinate with hospitals, surgery centers, vendors, and outside organizations
* Maintain physician credentialing, hospital privileges, insurance, and other required documentation
* Assist with hiring, onboarding, employee administration, and HR coordination
* Coordinate workers' compensation claims and communicate with HR and insurance providers
* Manage office supplies, inventory, vendors, and facility services
* Coordinate office technology, phone systems, internet, and other administrative systems
* Assist with accounts payable, banking, deposits, recurring payments, and financial administration
* Coordinate with the practice accountant and billing team
* Maintain patient payment systems and assist with payment-related administrative issues
* Coordinate website updates, marketing activities, and professional events
* Respond to media inquiries and coordinate physician interviews when appropriate
* Coordinate medical students, observers, and outside professional representatives
* Assist with practice projects, vendor transitions, technology implementations, and other operational initiatives
* Address patient concerns and administrative issues professionally
* Help maintain efficient communication between physicians, staff, patients, and outside organizations
* Assist with general front-office responsibilities when needed

**Office Operations**

The Office Manager will help ensure the office runs smoothly on a daily basis, including:

* Monitoring office supplies and backstock
* Maintaining organized exam rooms
* Coordinating cleaning and maintenance services
* Coordinating equipment and technology needs
* Managing phone and communication systems
* Processing administrative paperwork and faxes
* Supporting front-office staff
* Helping identify and resolve operational problems
* Maintaining organized practice records

**Financial & Administrative Responsibilities**

Experience with financial administration is a plus. Responsibilities may include:

* Accounts payable
* Vendor invoices
* Business banking
* Electronic payments
* Patient payment systems
* Deposits
* Monthly financial documentation
* Coordination with the billing company
* Coordination with the practice accountant
* Maintaining appropriate administrative financial records

The Office Manager will work within established practice procedures and will escalate accounting, tax, legal, or other specialized financial matters to the appropriate professional.

**What We're Looking For**

* Previous experience as a **medical office manager, practice manager, healthcare administrator, or similar role**
* Strong organizational and time-management skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through
* Comfortable working with electronic medical records and practice-management systems
* Experience with staff coordination and office operations
* Experience with medical billing, insurance, or healthcare administration is a plus
* Experience with accounts payable or financial administration is a plus
* Comfortable working with vendors and outside organizations
* Strong computer and technology skills
* Professional and compassionate communication with patients
* Ability to maintain strict patient and business confidentiality

**The Ideal Candidate**

You are a **problem solver and self-starter** who can see what needs to be done and take ownership of getting it done.

You are organized without needing constant supervision, comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities, and good at following a project from the initial idea through implementation.

You should be comfortable working in a small medical practice where responsibilities can vary from day to day. One day you may be coordinating a physician's schedule or credentialing paperwork, and another day you may be working with a vendor, resolving a patient concern, or helping solve an office technology issue.

Experience in **plastic surgery, gender-affirming care, or another surgical practice** is a plus.

**About Genesis Surgical Arts**

Genesis Surgical Arts is a specialized plastic surgery practice providing comprehensive surgical care in a professional, patient-centered environment.

Our team works closely with patients throughout their care and is committed to maintaining a well-organized, respectful, and supportive practice environment.

**To apply:** Please submit your resume and a brief description of your medical practice management or healthcare administrative experience.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

APTIM is seeking a Senior EHS Manager to lead environmental, health, and safety programs supporting a multidisciplinary research and development laboratory environment in the greater Seattle area.

In this role, you will partner with researchers, laboratory leadership, and operations teams to address complex safety challenges and integrate safe practices into evolving research activities. You will provide strategic direction and hands-on technical expertise across chemical safety, industrial hygiene, laser and non-ionizing radiation safety, lithium-ion batteries, and biosafety.

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:**

* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of laboratory EHS programs.
* Serve as a senior technical advisor to researchers and leadership on laboratory hazards, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
* Conduct and oversee exposure assessments, industrial hygiene monitoring, hazard evaluations, and control recommendations.
* Evaluate new research activities, equipment, materials, and laboratory modifications to identify hazards and establish appropriate safeguards.
* Lead inspections, incident investigations, and corrective actions to strengthen laboratory safety performance.
* Oversee chemical management, hazard communication, compressed-gas safety, and hazardous-material storage practices.
* Develop laboratory safety procedures, emergency-response plans, and employee training.
* Partner with facilities, engineering, and operations teams to incorporate safety into laboratory design and daily operations.
* Monitor program performance, communicate priorities to leadership, and mentor EHS and laboratory personnel.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in industrial hygiene, occupational safety, environmental health, chemistry, biology, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of progressively responsible EHS experience, including leadership of laboratory or R&D safety programs.
* Strong knowledge of laboratory hazards, industrial hygiene practices, and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Experience conducting exposure assessments, interpreting monitoring results, and implementing effective hazard controls.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives, exercise independent judgment, and influence cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and EHS documentation systems.
* Ability to work onsite in the greater Seattle area at least three days per week and travel between local laboratory locations.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and an acceptable driving record.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment and work safely in laboratory environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a related discipline.
* Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certified Safety Professional (CSP), or comparable certification.
* Experience supporting multiple laboratory locations.
* Specialized experience in laser safety, biosafety, non-ionizing radiation, or lithium-ion battery research and testing.
* Current HAZWOPER training.

**About APTIM**

APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.

* Work that is worthy of your time and talent
* Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
* Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
* A voice in making our company better
* Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $120-$150K per year and depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

**Employee Benefits**

APTIM Environmental & Infrastructure, LLC is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families through the APTIM Benefits Marketplace https://aptim.makeityoursource.com/.

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and several carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
* Company paid and optional Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity coverage
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave (eligibility based on company policy and applicable law)

* + APTIM 401(k) Guide

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand.
