**Global Accounts Payable & Expense Operations Analyst - Contingent Worker**

**Position Summary**

The Accounts Payable & Expense Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP), Travel & Expense (T&E),operations while serving as the functional subject matter expert for enterprise financial systems. This role combines operational excellence with systems expertise to ensure accurate invoice processing, employee expense reimbursements, supplier management, corporate card administration, payment operations, and enterprise application support.

The position partners closely with Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Human Resources, Payroll, IT, external vendors, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) providers to ensure efficient, compliant, and reliable financial operations across a global organization. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and experienced in supporting enterprise applications including Coupa Invoicing, Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM), SAP Concur, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText Vendor Invoice Management (VIM), and related financial systems.

Routine AP and Expense transactional operations are primarily performed by the BPO provider. This role oversees BPO service delivery, monitors operational performance and controls, supports the resolution of escalated issues, and drives process and system improvements. The Analyst may also directly perform selected operational activities to support exceptions, escalations, transitions, business continuity, or other operational requirements.

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid (2–3 days per week in the office based on business and team requirements).

**Key Responsibilities**

Depending on business needs and the defined operating model, the responsibilities below may be fulfilled through oversight of the BPO provider, direct execution by the Analyst, or a combination of both. **Accounts Payable & Supplier Operations**

* Process supplier invoices accurately using Coupa Invoicing, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText VIM, and related applications.
* Process Relish invoices and ensure timely and accurate payment processing.
* Manage supplier onboarding, registration, maintenance, and vendor master records through Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM).
* Review, validate, and resolve invoice discrepancies, exceptions, and workflow issues.
* Perform vendor account reconciliations and resolve outstanding balances.
* Process and monitor supplier payments while ensuring compliance with company policies and financial controls.
* Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to Accounts Payable.
* Ensure compliance with SOX, audit requirements, tax regulations, and internal controls.

**Expense & Corporate Card Operations**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee expense reimbursement and corporate card issues outside the scope of the BPO provider.
* Administer Corporate Card programs across multiple regions, including account setup, maintenance, credit limit requests, delinquency monitoring, employee terminations, dormant account reviews, and dispute resolution.
* Investigate reimbursement issues, duplicate payments, rejected payment files, payment exceptions, and policy violations.
* Validate reimbursement payment batches and reconcile payment files prior to processing.
* Partner with Treasury, Payroll, HR, Procurement, Finance, Tax, and external vendors to resolve operational issues.
* Escalate significant financial, operational, or compliance risks to leadership.

**Enterprise Systems & Functional Support**

* Provide functional support for SAP Concur, Coupa, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText VIM, and related enterprise applications.
* Investigate and resolve application issues including:
  + Employee provisioning failures
  + ERP interface failures
  + SAP IDoc processing issues
  + Corporate Card feed failures
  + Expense application and mobile issues
  + Enterprise integration failures
* Analyze system dependencies, determine business impact, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with IT and software vendors.
* Support production issue validation and act as the functional liaison between Finance and IT.

**Testing, Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, system upgrades, releases, implementations, and application enhancements.
* Develop test plans, document defects, validate fixes, and coordinate production readiness.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and operational efficiencies across Accounts Payable and Expense functions.
* Participate in Finance transformation initiatives, Procure-to-Pay projects, and cross-functional business initiatives.
* Prepare operational reports and analyze performance metrics.

**Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process documentation, workflows, and system documentation.
* Create employee communications, FAQs, training materials, and job aids.
* Support knowledge transfer, cross-training, and business continuity planning.
* Maintain documentation reposit

new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

The Moore Law Group is committed to superior compliance in legal collections. The firm emphasizes treating everyone it interacts with dignity, respect, compassion, and professionalism.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Process Documentation and Training Specialist develops and maintains documented workflows, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and role-specific training across The Moore Law Group. This position works directly with employees and department leaders to capture how work is performed, translate operational and client requirements into clear resources, and support consistent employee performance. The role coordinates a phased firmwide documentation effort and maintains accessible, current materials in collaboration with department leaders, Legal, Compliance, IT, and HR.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:
* Observe employees and interview department leaders to document responsibilities, systems, workflow steps, decision points, exceptions, and handoffs.
* Build and maintain a firmwide inventory of processes and existing documentation; coordinate priorities, deadlines, and a phased rollout with leadership.
* Create standardized procedures and detailed work instructions using screenshots, process maps, checklists, and examples as appropriate.
* Develop role-specific training presentations, onboarding resources, job aids, knowledge checks, and refresher materials based on approved procedures.
* Work with Client Services, Compliance, Legal, and department leaders to incorporate client requirements into procedures and training while preserving differences by client, state, or business channel.
* Use firm-approved AI tools to assist with content development and updates; protect confidential information and verify content with subject matter experts before publication.
* Coordinate department, legal, compliance, and client-related reviews and approvals before publishing materials.
* Organize a central, searchable collection of approved resources; collaborate with IT and HR to maintain SharePoint intranet content, accessibility, and publication practices.
* Establish document ownership, version control, review schedules, and update procedures to keep materials current as systems, workflows, and requirements change.
* Facilitate training as needed, gather employee and manager feedback, and revise materials to improve understanding and practical use.
* Travel to firm locations for employee observation, interviews, documentation, and training; perform other related duties as assigned.
* Establish consistent documentation and training templates, a firmwide process inventory, and a phased implementation plan with leadership.
* Complete approved procedures and role-specific training according to agreed priorities and deadlines.
* Maintain accurate, accessible materials that reflect approved practices and current client requirements, and use feedback to improve employee understanding and consistency.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)**

* Demonstrated professional experience documenting business processes, standard operating procedures, and detailed work instructions.
* Experience developing employee training, including presentations, onboarding resources, job aids, and assessments.
* Strong interviewing and observation skills, including the ability to identify steps and exceptions that experienced employees may not readily explain.
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex tasks into clear, practical instructions.
* Strong organization and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple departments, priorities, review cycles, and deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and PowerPoint and the ability to learn unfamiliar business systems.
* Practical experience using AI tools, or the ability to learn them quickly, with careful attention to accuracy and confidential information.
* Ability to work effectively with employees at all levels and obtain cooperation, feedback, and approvals across departments.
* Willingness and ability to travel to firm locations, including West Coast offices.
* Experience organizing or managing SharePoint content, preferred.
* Experience in legal services, financial services, collections, insurance, or another regulated environment, preferred.
* Familiarity with instructional design, adult learning principles, process mapping, screen recording, or e-learning tools, preferred.
* Experience building documentation or training programs across multiple departments or locations, preferred.
* Experience translating client requirements into operational procedures and employee training, preferred.

**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

As a Community Guide Case Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting our most vulnerable members, many dual-eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, through their most complex and serious situations, such as housing loss, safety concerns, and suspected abuse or neglect. When these challenges arise, cross-functional teams refer members to us for comprehensive support. As a Case Manager, you will build trusting, ongoing relationships with members and caregivers, create person-centered care plans, and remove barriers until goals are met. Reporting to a Community Guide Supervisor, you will use sound judgment and deep knowledge of community, behavioral health, and benefits resources to help members stay safe and stable, and you will strengthen the whole team by consulting on complex cases and coaching peers. This role is ideal for those dedicated to walking alongside members through their hardest moments as they navigate complex healthcare networks, community initiatives, and support resources.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

  

* Manage a caseload of members with complex, ongoing needs, building person-centered care plans with members and caregivers and following through until goals are met.
* Independently handle serious situations, including members expressing suicidal ideation, chronically unhoused members, housing loss or facility discharge, and suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation that requires an APS referral, following crisis and safety protocols.
* Lead emotionally complex conversations with members and caregivers, guiding them toward decisions rather than only sharing information.
* Remove barriers by connecting members directly to housing, behavioral health, long-term care, community, and benefits resources, and confirm that services were received.
* Coordinate with providers, teams across the health plan and Devoted Medical, community organizations, and government agencies so members don’t have to repeat their story.
* Anticipate risks before they become crises, look for root causes of recurring issues, and bring member patterns and proposed solutions to team leadership.
* Strengthen the team by leading or joining case conferences, consulting on complex cases, and coaching teammates on uncovering members’ underlying needs.
* Support the team’s core work, including common needs and benefit applications, during high-volume periods.
* Document thoroughly and track your own caseload outcomes, adjusting your approach before a leader needs to ask.

***Required skills and experience:***

  

* 2+ years of case management, care coordination, or social services experience supporting people with complex needs.
* Sound judgment in high-risk situations (crisis, safety concerns, suspected abuse or neglect), including knowing when and how to escalate.
* Strong verbal and written communication: you break down complex information clearly and handle emotionally sensitive conversations with composure.
* Strong organization to manage an ongoing caseload, competing priorities, and accurate documentation across multiple systems.

As a Bilingual (Spanish) Community Guide Case Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting our most vulnerable members, many dual-eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, through their most complex and serious situations, such as housing loss, safety concerns, and suspected abuse or neglect. As a Case Manager, you will build trusting, ongoing relationships with members and caregivers, create person-centered care plans, and remove barriers until goals are met. **Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

The Program Manager for UM Operations is a high-impact, hands-on leader responsible for driving consistency, workforce readiness, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency across the Utilization Management (UM) department.

This role combines advanced UM expertise, program management, and data-driven decision-making to build and lead programs that help UM teams perform at their best. The Program Manager will lead a team, partner closely with UM leadership and the UM OPS Quality Team, and ensure UM programs meet Regulatory Guidelines and CMS Regulations.

This is a fast-paced, high-change environment requiring someone who thrives on operational challenges, can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and is comfortable building and scaling programs during rapid growth.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

**Program Leadership & Team Management:**

* Lead section, priorities, and standards that support consistent, compliant operations across UM.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for program outcomes and report results to UM leadership.

**Training Program Development:**

* Build, implement, and manage the UM training program, establishing consistent curriculum and standards across all UM teams.
* Design and develop role-based training content for clinical and non-clinical UM staff and Medical Directors, using adult learning principles.
* Create and maintain training materials, job aids, e-learning, and a central training library that reflects current policies, criteria, and regulatory requirements.
* Translate SOPs, medical policies, regulatory requirements, and system changes into clear, practical training.

**Onboarding & Ongoing Education:**

* Oversee onboarding for all new UM hires, including orientation, classroom training, supervised nesting, and readiness sign-off before independent work.
* Establish role-based competency and readiness standards and partner with operational leaders on new-hire progress.
* Manage recurring monthly education and ad hoc education for new policies, regulatory changes, system releases, and criteria updates.
* Partner with the UM OPS Quality Team to deliver re-education for staff with poor quality performance and confirm improvement.
* Track attendance, completion, and attestation to support audit and accreditation readiness.

**Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR) Program:**

* Build and manage the UM IRR program for clinical reviewers and Medical Directors, including methodology, case development, scoring, and passing standards.
* Administer IRR assessments on schedule, oversee remediation and retesting, and use results to guide education priorities.
* Ensure IRR processes and documentation meet accreditation, state, and CMS requirements, and present results to UM leadership and committees.

**Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement:**

* Build dashboards and reports that measure program effectiveness, including time to productivity, IRR results, education completion, and impact on quality and turnaround times.
* Analyze program, IRR, and quality data to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement across UM.
* Lead initiatives to streamline UM workflows, quality decision making, reduce administrative burden, and improve consistency.

**Technology & AI Enablement:**

* Partner with Quality, Data Science, and Engineering to support adoption of AI/LLM-assisted workflows, including human-in-the-loop review and responsible use.
* Use AI and learning technology to scale program delivery and improve efficiency.
* Manage the tools and systems used to schedule, track, and report program activity.

**Cross-Functional Partnership:**

* Partner with UM leaders to identify needs and reduce the time leaders spend building and delivering training.
* Work closely with the UM OPS Quality Team to turn audit findings into action while keeping training and auditing independent.
* Collaborate with Compliance, Medical Directors, Pharmacy, Clinical Policy, and HR/Talent on regulatory updates, policy changes, and hiring plans.

***Required skills and experience:***

* Active, unrestricted RN or LVNlicense with 5+ years of UM experience (inpatient, outpatient, post-acute, or appeals).
* 2+ years of experience in clinical education, or UM training.
* People leadership experience.
* In-depth knowledge of UM processes, medical necessity criteria, accreditation standards, Regulatory Guidelines, and CMS Regulations.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and project management skills.

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Experience building or managing a training program, including onboarding and IRR or competency assessments.
* Knowledge of Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care UM requirements.
* Experience with LMS platforms and AI/LLM-enabled workflows in a healthcare environment.

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Implementation Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for leading the successful deployment of icobrain at customer sites across the U.S. and Canada, from project kickoff through go-live and handoff to ongoing support.

This role sits at the intersection of technology and clinical workflow. The successful candidate will plan and execute technical software implementations, connecting icobrain's cloud-based platform with customer MR scanners, PACS, and RIS environments through DICOM and HL7, while making sure each deployment fits the way the customer's MR department works day to day.

Because icobrain is a growing part of the GE HealthCare MR portfolio, this role will also help formulate and document the implementation process itself, building the repeatable workflows, playbooks, and standards that allow the team to scale.

* **Support existing customers and contract transitions:** Partner with Customer Success on reconfigurations, upgrades, site expansions, and the technical aspects of transitioning legacy icometrix customers to GE HealthCare agreements.
* **Bring the voice of the customer back to the organization:** Share implementation insights, recurring technical issues, and customer feedback with Product, Customer Success, and MR leadership to improve both the product and the implementation experience.

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of experience leading technical software implementations, ideally in healthcare IT, medical imaging, clinical software, or a related field.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
new_jobs.description:
#### **About the role**

Roasters, cafes and producers know their coffee. As a **Customer Success Manager**, you help them run the business around it: onboarding, adoption, renewals and growth. Cropster keeps 95% of its customers after 15 years. You help us keep it that way, one relationship at a time.  
  
You listen first, understand what each customer is trying to achieve, and show how Cropster gets them there. You manage your portfolio independently, and you work with Product, Marketing and Support when a customer needs more than one person can give.  
This is a fully remote role. For optimal team collaboration across global time zones, you regularly work flexibly in US Eastern or Central time hours, so you overlap with customers and the team.

#### **What you'll do**

**Look after your customer portfolio**

* Know where every account stands: priorities, risks, renewals and growth opportunities.
* Balance onboarding, trials, renewals, billing questions, support issues and commercial opportunities, and ask for help early when priorities collide.
* Keep CRM records current: interactions, account health and next steps.

**Help customers adopt Cropster and stay**

* Guide customers from trial through onboarding with clear next steps and regular contact.
* Hold regular check-ins to connect product features to customer goals, and follow up on every open action.
* Watch engagement and adoption to spot churn risks early, and talk about them openly with the customer.
* Lead discovery calls and product demos with existing accounts.

**Grow accounts**

* Spot expansion, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, including added services and subscription upgrades, and follow them through.
* Reach out to inactive customers and rebuild the relationship.
* Analyze account performance and give customers practical recommendations.
* Work towards agreed targets for retention, expansion revenue, outreach and pipeline, with a clear status and next step for every opportunity.

**Work together**

* Bring customer feedback and feature requests to Product and Marketing.
* Work with colleagues across teams so customers hear one answer, not three.

**What success looks like**

* Customers hear from you proactively and get timely follow-up.
* Trials, onboarding and commercial opportunities always have a next step.
* You know the health, risks, renewals and growth opportunities across your portfolio.
* Your pipeline and CRM data are accurate.
* You keep your commitments and show progress against agreed retention and revenue targets.

#### **We are looking for someone with**

* A degree in business, marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience in Customer Success.
* Several years in Customer Success or customer service, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a record of improving retention and satisfaction.
* Experience managing a high-volume portfolio while keeping contact consistent.
* Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish, written and spoken. Portuguese is a plus.
* Clear, concise communication and real care for your customer’s outcome.
* Commercial awareness: you notice risks and revenue opportunities and follow them through.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing tasks.
* Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Initiative and follow-through, and openness about where you need support.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* The ability to adapt when priorities change.

#### **That said, we’d be particularly delighted to hire someone with**

* Experience in the coffee industry, or familiarity with Cropster’s products or market.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* An understanding of technical SaaS products and subscription models.
* Availability for occasional travel to industry events and customer visits (15-20%). If travel is difficult for you, tell us and we’ll talk.

You don’t need to tick every box. If this role sounds like you, apply. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion or background. If you need adjustments during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll arrange them.

#### **What you can expect**

The base salary range for this position is **$70K to $80K USD gross base/year** + 20% variable compensation potential. We look at factors like your experience, location and individual qualifications to determine our offer. Additional benefits include medical, dental and vision health plans, employer-provided HRA, 401k with employer contribution, budgets for education & wellbeing, and professional development, a co-working benefit to support remote work, very flexible working hours without core hours, paid time for volunteer work, access to mental health support, and discounts for really great coffee. We also make our best possible offer upfront - no games!  
  
**Hiring timeline**: We are starting the interview process now and aim to hire by mid-January 2027. Interested but concerned about the timeline, apply and leave a note

#### **Apply now**

We look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact our team at jobs@cropster.com.  
  
This position is open for immediate hire. Currently, Cropster will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the US for this opening.

#### **About us**

Cropster is a team of coffee enthusiasts. We build the platform that connects coffee workflows from bean to cup.

As a Certified B Corp™, we work to make coffee more sustainable, transparent, and community-driven, and to amplify our positive impact along the way.

**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. **Job Summary:**
----------------

The AI Enablement Lead helps Opensity Solutions put AI to work safely and effectively. This person trains and coaches employees at every skill level, builds practical apps and automations, and keeps all AI use within the AI Acceptable Use Policy.

Opensity is a global managed services provider serving law firms, financial services organizations, and other highly regulated clients. This hands-on individual contributor role reports to the VP of IT and works closely with Information Security, the Data Governance Board, HR, Legal, and Executive Leadership Team sponsors.

**Backgrounds That Fit This Role:**

Strong candidates often hold roles like these and bring advanced, self-directed generative AI skills:

* Corporate trainer or learning and development specialist
* Change management or digital adoption lead
* Technical trainer or customer success engineer at a software company
* Citizen developer or power user (Power Automate, Power BI, ChatGPT)
* IT service management or knowledge management professional

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Enablement and Adoption**

* Lead the company-wide AI adoption program: role-based training, new user onboarding, and an AI champions network.
* Coach employees at every comfort level through live training, demos, office hours, and one-on-one support.
* Partner with Executive Leadership Team sponsors to identify use cases and build the apps, workflows, and automations that deliver them.
* Publish and maintain guidance on when to use Claude versus Microsoft Copilot.
* Build adoption plans for seat holders whose usage falls below expectations.

**Governance**

* Run AI tool intake and review with Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement before any tool or integration goes live.
* Manage the Claude and Copilot license lifecycle, from sponsor approval through training and policy acknowledgment.

* Represent IT on AI matters at the Data Governance Board.

**Compliance**

* Keep AI use consistent with the AI Acceptable Use Policy, Employee Handbook, and client contracts.
* Coordinate high-risk use case reviews and confirm written approvals before work begins, including HR and Legal approval for any use touching employment decisions.
* Support Information Security with AI evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and client audits.

**Reporting**

* Run the quarterly AI usage audit against Executive Leadership Team thresholds.
* Maintain dashboards on adoption, usage, spend, and policy exceptions.
* Report AI value in hours saved and cost avoided, with monthly updates to IT leadership and quarterly summaries for the Executive Leadership Team.

**What Success Looks Like**

* 90 days: AI tool inventory complete; license and audit process running; first usage report delivered.
* 6 months: Claude and Copilot guidance published; champions active in every business unit; 10 or more documented use cases with measured time savings.
* 1 year: AI audit evidence ready; utilization above target for most seats; AI value included in the IT business case.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5 or more years in IT, technology enablement, change management, or adoption roles, including at least 1 year hands-on with generative AI or automation tools.
* Experience deploying enterprise AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or ChatGPT Enterprise.
* A portfolio of apps, automations, or agents built with AI tools or Power Platform.
* Patience and skill teaching non-technical and skeptical users.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and data protection basics.
* Experience working within governance and approval processes.
* Clear writer and presenter for audiences from frontline staff to executives.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Managed services provider (MSP) experience.
* Experience in legal, financial services, or other confidentiality-driven environments.
* Experience building agents, skills, connectors, or MCP integrations.
* Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, or ISO/IEC 42001.
* Certifications such as Prosci, IAPP AIGP, or Microsoft Azure AI Engineer.

**Working Conditions**

* Some early-morning or evening meetings with international teams, including the Philippines.
* Occasional travel, up to 10%.
* Remote work requires Company approval and Company-issued equipment.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunities for growth and learning in an IT career path.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.

The compensation range for this role is USD 125,000 to 185,000 per year and may include an annual bonus. Actual compensation within that range will be dependent upon the individual's location, skills, experience and qualifications.

Medical insurance

Paid Time Off

new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Office Manager serves as the administrative coordination hub for the Executive Director and Director of Operations. This high-trust role manages calendars, leadership follow-up, meeting preparation, document organization, internal communications, office systems and cross-department project tracking. The position anticipates deadlines, brings outstanding items to leadership’s attention and helps ensure decisions are translated into assigned, documented and completed next steps. The Office Manager coordinates work but does not independently make trustee, legal, personnel or financial approval decisions.

Executive Leadership & Calendar Support

· Manage and prioritize executive calendars, meeting invitations, scheduling conflicts, agendas, reminders and follow-up deadlines for the Executive Director and Director of Operations.

· Provide high-level administrative and organizational support to the Executive Director and Director of Operations, ensuring leadership priorities, projects, and operational responsibilities remain organized and on schedule.

· Develop and maintain a centralized leadership tracking system identifying key priorities, assigned owners, deadlines, project statuses, dependencies, outstanding deliverables, and matters requiring escalation.

· Proactively monitor deadlines, identify potential delays, follow up with responsible team members, and escalate unresolved matters to the appropriate leadership personnel.

· Prepare concise weekly executive summaries highlighting completed initiatives, upcoming deadlines, outstanding action items, operational concerns, and decisions requiring leadership attention.

· Assist leadership in prioritizing competing responsibilities and maintaining accountability across departments.

· Prepare meeting briefs, talking points, presentations, correspondence and organized background materials for leadership review.

· Coordinate leadership travel, conferences, appointments and related logistics within approved budgets and policies.

· Protect confidential executive, personnel, Board and beneficiary information; route sensitive decisions to authorized leaders.

Board Governance & Executive Meetings

· Coordinate Board and committee meeting calendars, invitations, agenda drafts, document collection, presentation assembly and timely distribution of approved materials.

· Organize Board portal materials and version control; track requested follow-up items and approved action deadlines.

· Collaborate with the Director of Operations to plan, organize, and coordinate CPT Institute’s annual Board Retreat, including scheduling, logistics, agendas, meeting materials, accommodations, and communication with Board Members.

· Assist with documenting retreat discussions, action items, and follow-up responsibilities to ensure organizational priorities and Board directives are communicated and implemented.

· Assist with meeting minutes and action summaries when assigned, subject to leadership review and approval.

· Prepare meeting agendas in advance, gather departmental updates, and ensure leadership has the necessary information to conduct productive meetings.

· Maintain an annual governance and reporting calendar for recurring meetings, approvals and administrative deadlines.

Operations & Project Coordination

· Coordinate cross-functional projects for the Director of Operations, maintaining timelines, task owners, milestone dashboards and follow-up reminders.

· Monitor outstanding operational requests and identify bottlenecks, overdue tasks or items requiring management attention.

· Organize standard operating procedures, templates, internal forms and shared reference materials; coordinate updates approved by department leaders.

· Compile accurate operational KPIs and status reports from designated data owners without independently certifying underlying financial or trust data.

· Help streamline internal workflows, handoffs, documentation standards and recurring administrative processes.

Nonprofit Trustee Administrative Support

· Coordinate secure collection, routing, filing and tracking of trust-related administrative documents at the direction of authorized trust administration staff.

· Assist with document checklists, signature logistics, correspondence and deadline reminders; escalate incomplete or time-sensitive items.

· Coordinate with Trust Administration, Finance, legal counsel and external partners on scheduling and administrative follow-up, without offering legal or benefits advice.

· Follow confidentiality, record retention, access-control and information-security procedures for beneficiary and organizational records.

Office Administration, Vendors & Technology

· Oversee day-to-day administrative workflows, office supplies, equipment, mail routing and vendor service requests.

· Maintain organized electronic filing, document naming conventions and access permissions in collaboration with system owners.

· Coordinate technology onboarding, equipment requests, software access changes and troubleshooting with authorized IT personnel.

· Track routine vendor renewals, invoices and service issues for review by the appropriate approver; do not independently commit funds beyond delegated authority.

**Departmental Meeting Oversight and Accountability**

· Coordinate with department leaders to ensure all CPT Institute departments conduct regularly scheduled team meetings to maintain communication, accountability, and operational consistency.

· Establish and maintain a centralized schedule of departmental meetings, ensuring appropriate meeting frequency and participation.

· Monitor the timely submission of weekly departmental reports to the Executive Director and Director of Operations.

· Assist in standardizing departmental reporting formats to include accomplishments, key performance indicators (KPIs), pending assignments, operational challenges, staffing concerns, and upcoming priorities.

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience).
* 2-5 years of professional experience, including:

o Experience in training, onboarding, operations, or related roles

o Experience in legal, court reporting, or related environments

**W****ork Environment**

* This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.
* All work is conducted through secure, company-approved technology platforms via computer, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
* Reliable high-speed internet access and a private, secure workspace are required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods at a computer workstation in a remote, home-based environment.
* Ability to perform repetitive motions, including frequent typing, keyboarding, and use of a mouse or other input devices.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist - Upstate New York & New England
new_jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Varian Medical Systems, a Siemens Healthineers company is hiring a Clinical Training Specialist (CSL) for the Upstate New York & New England area supporting Varian Interventional Solutions (VIS) by providing in‑person case coverage, clinical education, and first-line technical support for VIS products. This role trains and guides physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on proper product use, assists during procedures in a hands‑off clinical support capacity, and ensures equipment, disposables, and procedural documentation are fully managed. The specialist also supports product installations, addresses customer training needs, contributes to medical affairs activities, and represents VIS at trainings, demos, and industry events. The position requires strong clinical knowledge (IR/CT, OR, sterile technique), excellent communication skills, and the ability to work in fast‑paced procedural environments.
  
  
\*\*The role requires approximately 60% travel throughout the territory, including Upstate New York, Vermont, Massachusetts, and Maine, with driving and overnight travel to customer sites as business needs require.\*\*

**What You will do:**

***Provide in-person case coverage***

* Ensure product/s and ancillary components are available for each case.
* Complete and process all procedure related paperwork as required.
* Track and report all customer complaints.
* Ensure physicians and staff have the most current information available.
* Manage a disposable inventory sufficient to cover assigned case load.
* Bring products (including Microwave and Cryoablation generators) to cases as required.

***Train and educate physicians and hospital staff on use of assigned VIS products***

* Provide on-site clinical support during procedures while maintaining a “hands off” posture in relation to direct patient contact.
* Interact with customers and functional organizations to determine their training needs and use engineering documentation such as Operators Manuals and DFUs to develop content of courses.
* May coordinate or lead customer and/or employee training classes.
* May also conduct large group presentations at seminars, training programs, and trade shows.
* May also provide demo support to local, regional and national customer trade events.

***Provide first line product technical support***

* Perform new installation support to ensure products are working as specified.
* Provide first line technical service support via Engineering or Field Service Engineer oversight, when necessary.

***Collaborate with the VIS Medical Affairs Team***

* Assist Medical Education, Medical Information, and Medical Science Liaisons if required.
* Document day to day interactions with physician customers.
* Provide competitive product performance information to headquarters marketing or engineering groups.

**What You will have:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in related field preferred.
* Clinical Background – IR/CT Technician, Operating Room Nurse or Surgical Technician preferred.
* Experience/Knowledge of IR suite, Operating Room Protocol and Sterile Technique.
* Experience in supporting vascular procedures highly regarded.
* Experience in supporting tissue ablation procedures highly regarded.
* Ability to work in a high-intensity, fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail oriented with excellent organizational skills.
* Analytical with an ability/desire to solve problems.
* Team player.
* Ability to lift approx. 150 pounds
* Ability to travel regional and locally (approximately 50%).

***Vendor Credentialing Requirements***

* Many Varian clients require employees and representatives to meet certain “Vendor Credentialing” requirements before they will be allowed to have access to their sites.
* This position requires having full access to client sites to perform the essential functions of this position.
* Unless prohibited by law, candidate must meet all Vendor Credentialing requirements necessary to have full client access, and must continue to meet those requirements during the course of employment in this position.
* These requirements vary by client and may include, but are not limited to: Proof of valid identification (photo, driver’s license, SSN), Criminal background checks, Drug screens, Immunizations (Hep B, MMR, Varicella, Influenza, Tetanus), Annual TB testing.

***This role is governed by our Fleet Safety Policy. To be eligible for employment, applicants must hold a valid driver’s license in the state they reside and a satisfactory driving record***

#LI-Remote

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About The Princeton Review**

The Princeton Review is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of college- and graduate school–bound students achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company's Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 22 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

**About the Position**

We're looking for a detail-obsessed, quick-learning Revenue Operations Specialist to join our remote team and keep our revenue data accurate, visible, and actionable. In this role, you'll track and forecast revenue across accounts, reconcile records with Accounting, and manage revenue data in Salesforce. You'll also guide Sales and Customer Success toward the highest-priority accounts to close each month.

Day to day, you'll write Standard Operating Procedures, audit internal systems, and work with teams across the company (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Accounts Receivable, and senior leadership) to resolve invoicing questions quickly and accurately. You'll also take on special projects, including building a new invoicing process in Salesforce, managing non-standard contract compliance, serving as the Sales and Marketing liaison on lead list management and CCPA compliance, and helping launch new Sales Enablement tools such as a Sales Playbook on SharePoint.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify and track all potential revenue earnings for each account, report to Leadership weekly, and reconcile records with Accounting monthly.
* Guide the Sales and Customer Success teams to maximize impact on revenue by identifying high priority accounts to close each month.
* Design and write Standard Operating Procedures when needed to improve accuracy, efficiency, and usability for internal teams.
* Coordinate with multiple internal teams to ensure quick and accurate response to customer inquiries regarding invoicing.
* Verify and input sales credits and debits into our internal tools to guarantee customer account balances as displayed accessible and accurate for our clients.
* Audit data entries and program statuses in our internal systems.
* Effectively communicate system needs to Salesforce Administrator and Sales Operations leadership to support design of technological tools that will improve workflow for business unit.
* Design and maintain a new invoicing process that bridges information in our proprietary Customer Service Tool and Salesforce.
* Manage non-standard contract compliance and reporting, using Claude AI and Salesforce to identify and track requirements.
* Serve as a liaison between Sales and Marketing regarding lead list management and sales follow-through.
* Write, build, and maintain the Sales Playbook on SharePoint.

**Who You Are**

* 3-5 years of Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales experience, preferably in B2B SaaS
* Extremely detail oriented, prone to checking every last number and data point
* Ability to quickly learn new concepts and systems.
* Adept at using Excel for data entry, data preparation and some data analysis: pivot tables, vlookups, sumifs are all important to this position
* Knowledgeable of general accounting principles related to deferred revenue calculations and reporting
* Comfortable running reports in Salesforce Lightning and navigating the Salesforce environment.
* SharePoint experience preferred
* Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude to improve efficiencies in workflow
* Ability to interface professionally and effectively with many personality types from various departments including senior management, sales and service, marketing, legal team, and accounts receivables
* Work quickly, independently and remotely with an ability to adapt to changes in priority as needed
* Collaborate with, support, and lean on teammates when needed
* Willing to put in extra time during our busiest season with the understanding that flexibility will be reciprocated

The National Account Manager executes transformational sales strategies for assigned customers, defined as Tier 2 or 1, driving growth and profitability.
